method.zh: 逐条查阅公开论文、作者项目与官方仓库，记录任务协议与指标可核验程度。能力为有依据的编辑关联，并非独立因果测量；仅具体游戏或任务的交互协议计入游玩覆盖，合集不向子游戏自动继承能力。
method.en: Public papers, author projects and official repositories were checked per record. Capability links are evidence-bounded editorial associations, not isolated causal measurements. Gameplay coverage requires game- or task-scoped interactive protocols; suite capabilities do not automatically propagate to members.

task.zh: 在八个规则化游戏中按提示推理并对抗另一模型。
task.en: Reason from prompts and play another model in eight rule-based games.

observation.zh: 游戏状态、规则和预定义策略/子问题提示。
observation.en: Game state, rules, and predefined strategy/subproblem prompts.

action.zh: 回答中间子问题并给出执行动作。
action.en: Answer intermediate subproblems and emit an executable move.

metrics.zh: 结果收益/最大收益；胜和负取1/0/−1；中间问题准确率/F1单独报告。
metrics.en: Outcome reward/max reward; win/draw/loss = 1/0/−1; intermediate accuracy/F1 separately.

controls.zh: 每模型对20局、双方各先手10次；4096输出token；随机玩家基线。
controls.en: 20 matches per model pair, ten first-player seats each; 4,096 output tokens; random baseline.

limits.zh: 人为CoT策略提示参与性能；中间推理分不是自由推理的客观全能力测量。
limits.en: Prescriptive strategy/CoT prompts affect performance; intermediate scores do not measure unrestricted reasoning.

basis.zh: 对抗结果反映规则内的动作选择与收益。
basis.en: Competitive outcomes reflect action choice and payoff under rules.

limits.zh: 不代表完整通关率；训练和保留关卡范围以原文为准，重力翻转未覆盖；30/60 FPS 比较为单独实验。

findings.zh: 附录B表1明确50个ID、10个Near-OOD、5个Far-OOD评测对象；这是表征冻结后的适配协议，游戏名称相同也须保留其分布角色。
findings.en: Appendix B Table 1 identifies 50 ID, 10 near-OOD and 5 far-OOD evaluation targets; this is frozen-representation adaptation and split roles must be preserved.

basis.zh: 全文5.3–5.4补50/10/5划分、冻结骨干、5万适应预算和不同归一化参照；能力限显式迁移评测。 本轮归属复核：附录B表1明确50个ID、10个Near-OOD、5个Far-OOD评测对象；这是表征冻结后的适配协议，游戏名称相同也须保留其分布角色。
basis.en: Sections 5.3–5.4 establish 50/10/5 splits, frozen backbones, 50K adaptation budgets and different normalization references; capability is limited to explicit transfer evaluation. Routing review: Appendix B Table 1 identifies 50 ID, 10 near-OOD and 5 far-OOD evaluation targets; this is frozen-representation adaptation and split roles must be preserved.

task.zh: 从固定质量/规模轨迹训练，再在留出关卡实际运行

controls.zh: 每游戏 100 测试回合、5 模型种子；控制数据多样性、数量和技能水平
controls.en: 100 test episodes/game, five model seeds; control data diversity, size and skill

limits.zh: 跨关卡泛化不是跨游戏泛化；WebShop 不计入游戏
limits.en: Level generalization is not cross-game transfer; exclude WebShop

basis.zh: 明确区分训练轨迹关卡与未见测试关卡

findings.zh: 依据官方配置的实际数组关联46款：9款在线选参、37款离线选择评测。配置中的旧注释写45/36，与数组数量不符，因此以数组和论文为准。
findings.en: Route forty-six explicit configuration entries: nine tuning and thirty-seven evaluation games. Stale 45/36 comments disagree with the executable lists and paper.

basis.zh: 全文3.3、4.3与表3核验46款而非ALE全部57款，9/37策略选择划分和最佳数据策略归一化；只登记Atari部分。 本轮归属复核：依据官方配置的实际数组关联46款：9款在线选参、37款离线选择评测。配置中的旧注释写45/36，与数组数量不符，因此以数组和论文为准。
basis.en: Sections 3.3/4.3 and table 3 verify 46 games rather than all 57 ALE titles, the 9/37 selection split and best-data-policy normalization; Atari only. Routing review: Route forty-six explicit configuration entries: nine tuning and thirty-seven evaluation games. Stale 45/36 comments disagree with the executable lists and paper.

evidence.title: Enhancing Human Experience in Human-Agent Collaboration: A Human-Centered Modeling Approach Based on Positive Human Gain
evidence.excerpt: Sections 4.1–4.3 and Appendix B describe 5v5 Honor of Kings, a fixed human-model teammate, 10,000-game tests and human-goal indicators.

label.zh: 王者荣耀人类模型队友协作

task.zh: 四个 AI 与一个固定人类行为模型组队，与固定混合队伍进行 5v5 对局，同时提升队友目标表现。
task.en: Four agents team with one fixed human-behavior model in 5v5 matches against a fixed mixed team, improving teammate-goal outcomes.

observation.zh: 英雄、单位及比赛统计等结构化特征和空间特征；不可见敌方信息只用于训练价值网络。
observation.en: Structured hero/unit/game statistics and spatial features; hidden enemy information is restricted to the training value network.

action.zh: 移动、选定目标攻击、技能、召唤师能力、回城、物品等游戏控制。
action.en: Movement, targeted attacks, skills, summoner ability, recall and item controls.

metrics.zh: 胜率；人类模型的 MVP 分、精彩操作次数、参团率、资源量及跟随率。
metrics.en: Win rate; human-model MVP score, highlights, participation, resources and follow rate.

controls.zh: JueWu-SL 人类模型，固定对手为四个 Wukong 加一个人类模型；每配置 10,000 局、五个训练种子、95% 置信区间。
controls.en: JueWu-SL human model; fixed opponents comprise four Wukong agents and one human model; 10,000 matches per configuration, five training seeds and 95% confidence intervals.

limits.zh: 这里只纳入模拟人类队友协议，不能把代理指标当成真实人类主观体验；不合并另行开展的人类实验。
limits.en: Only the simulated-human teammate protocol is included; proxy indicators are not subjective human experience, and separate human studies are not pooled.

basis.zh: 共享团队胜利目标，同时适应人类模型队友的行为与目标。
basis.en: Agents share a team objective while adapting to a human-model teammate and its goals.

evidence.title: Enhancing Human Experience in Human-Agent Collaboration: A Human-Centered Modeling Approach Based on Positive Human Gain
evidence.excerpt: Sections 4.1–4.3 and Appendix B describe 5v5 Honor of Kings, a fixed human-model teammate, 10,000-game tests and human-goal indicators.

reviewedScope.en: Automated matches with a fixed human-model teammate.

observation.en: Unit/state features and human location-event signals.

action.en: Movement, skills, target selection and meta-commands.

metrics.zh: 胜率和参与者协作合理性/总体偏好。
metrics.en: Win rate and participant reasonableness/preference ratings.

controls.zh: 30 名参与者；固定 MC-Base 对手；人机实验禁止 AI 间通信。
controls.en: 30 participants; fixed MC-Base opponents; no agent-agent communication in human tests.

limits.zh: 专用游戏授权及训练系统；非通用自然语言协商。
limits.en: Requires game access/training setup; not open-ended language negotiation.

basis.zh: 通信选择与共同胜率直接对应协作。
basis.en: Communication and shared win rate operationalize coordination.

basis.zh: 改变人类队友人数与水平。
basis.en: Human teammate number/skill are varied.

records.noteZh: 确认 COPA 的修改版 SMAC 实际对局及胜率，限定为团队微操，不向资源采集或救援节点复制该协议。
records.noteEn: Confirmed COPA modified-SMAC matches and win rates, scoped to team micromanagement without copying the protocol to collection/rescue nodes.

evidence.title: Coach-Player Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Dynamic Team Composition
evidence.excerpt: Section 4.3 modifies SMAC 3–8sz and 3–8MMM with randomized groups, sight range three, and win-rate curves over three independent runs.

task.zh: 分布式控制一队作战单位击败敌队，教练周期性广播策略。
task.en: Control a team of combat units to defeat enemies, with periodic coach strategy broadcasts.

observation.zh: 玩家仅获局部可见单位信息；教练使用全局观察。
observation.en: Players receive local unit observations; the coach has global observations.

action.zh: SMAC 单位移动、攻击或医疗单位治疗等合法动作；教练提供策略变量。
action.en: Legal SMAC unit movement, attack or medic-heal actions; the coach supplies strategy variables.

metrics.zh: 对局胜率随训练过程变化及均值标准误；另报告通信频率。
metrics.en: Match win-rate learning curves and standard errors; communication frequency is separately reported.

controls.zh: 修改版 3–8sz/3–8MMM；己方随机分成 2–4 组、敌方 1–2 组，视野 3；三次独立运行。
controls.en: Modified 3–8sz/3–8MMM; allied units form 2–4 groups, enemies 1–2, sight range three; three independent runs.

limits.zh: 仅 SMAC 战斗微操，非完整星际争霸 II；不同队伍配置本身不证明未见配置泛化；保留原文地图与通信设置。
limits.en: SMAC combat only, not full StarCraft II; varied compositions alone do not establish held-out generalization; retain paper map and communication settings.

basis.zh: 各单位依据局部观察和教练信息共同击败敌队。

findings.zh: 关联全部21款已实验CardStock实现；使用明确的Valet变体节点，保留单局制、无传牌Hearts/Scarto、Block Rummy等规则差别。

basis.zh: 全文3核验每游戏200局组成及确定化MCTS搜索预算；保留游戏内分数分布，明确非统一胜率排行榜。 本轮归属复核：关联全部21款已实验CardStock实现；使用明确的Valet变体节点，保留单局制、无传牌Hearts/Scarto、Block Rummy等规则差别。
basis.en: Section3 verifies200-game composition per title and determinized-MCTS search budgets; metrics remain game-specific score distributions, not a universal win-rate leaderboard. Routing review: Route all twenty-one experimentally tested CardStock implementations as Valet variants, retaining single-deal, no-pass Hearts/Scarto and Block Rummy differences.

evidence.title: LUDOBENCH: Evaluating LLM Behavioural Decision-Making Through Spot-Based Board Game Scenarios in Ludo
evidence.excerpt: The main LudoBench evaluation is 480 single-decision spots, not complete long multi-agent games.

task.zh: 在480个局面、12类权衡中选一枚棋子。
task.en: Select one piece in 480 spots spanning 12 tradeoff categories.

observation.zh: 完整规则、棋盘、骰点；可加入人格或历史叙述。
observation.en: Rules, board, die value, optional persona or narrative history.

action.zh: piece_index及理由；引擎验证后可回退随机合法动作。
action.en: Piece index and reason; engine validation with random legal fallback.

metrics.zh: 与Expectiminimax基线一致率、各行为率、回退前非法率。
metrics.en: Agreement with Expectiminimax, behavioral rates, pre-fallback invalid rate.

controls.zh: 每类40局面；中性与报复提示使用相同棋盘；有效/无效输出分层。
controls.en: 40 spots per category; identical boards for neutral/grudge prompts; separate invalid outputs.

limits.zh: 单步局面不证明长期规划；搜索基线不是已证明最优策略。
limits.en: Single spots do not establish long-horizon planning; search baseline is not proven optimal.

basis.zh: 明确对照吃子、安全与终点推进的决策权衡。
basis.en: Explicitly contrasts capture, safety, and progress tradeoffs.

action.en: Submit a point contribution each round.

observation.zh: 地图、部队和补给中心状态，以及收到的谈判消息和过去经验。
observation.en: Map, units and supply centers, received negotiation messages and prior experience.

action.zh: 生成谈判消息并提交游戏合法军队命令。
action.en: Generate negotiation messages and submit legal military orders.

metrics.zh: Win/Most SC/Survived/Defeated 比例；C-Diplo Argir 得分；胜利阈值为 34 个中心中的至少 18 个。
metrics.en: Win/Most SC/Survived/Defeated rates and C-Diplo Argir scores; victory requires at least 18 of 34 centers.

controls.zh: 通常 1,000 局，随机分配国家；分别保留 3:4、4:3 Richelieu/Cicero 混合阵容及其他对手配置。
controls.en: Typically 1,000 games with randomized countries; retain separate 3:4 and 4:3 Richelieu/Cicero mixtures and other opponent configurations.

basis.en: Negotiation, alliance commitments and inferred intentions influence orders.

basis.zh: 各国竞争有限补给中心，需要选择结盟与攻防取舍。

records.noteEn: Added the precise ONUW child, scoped to five-player discussion/voting after fixed night events, not multi-night Werewolf.

evidence.title: Learning to Discuss Strategically: A Case Study on One Night Ultimate Werewolf
evidence.excerpt: Sections 6.1 and 6.3 evaluate five-player ONUW with predefined easy/hard roles and night actions, 30 repetitions and Team Village win-rate matrices.

label.zh: 单夜终极狼人讨论与投票
label.en: One Night Ultimate Werewolf discussion and voting

task.zh: 在五人固定夜间设置之后，通过讨论推断角色、影响他人，并投票争取己方阵营胜利。
task.en: After a fixed five-player night setup, discuss to infer roles, influence others and vote for the team outcome.

observation.zh: 自身可见角色与夜间信息、公共讨论历史；代理推断的信念不是环境真值。
observation.en: Privately visible role/night information and public discussion history; inferred beliefs are not environment ground truth.

action.zh: 选择讨论策略并生成发言，最后提交投票对象；本评测夜间动作预先固定。
action.en: Select discussion tactics and generate utterances, then vote for a player; night actions are predefined in this evaluation.

metrics.zh: 各 Agent 配对下村民阵营的胜率矩阵，每个评测重复 30 次。
metrics.en: Team Village win-rate matrix for agent matchups, with 30 repetitions per evaluation.

controls.zh: Easy/Hard 两套角色和夜间动作；Hard 中强盗交换狼人身份；各阵营用同版代理，§6.3 用 Gemini 后端，temperature 1.0。
controls.en: Easy/Hard role/night configurations; Hard swaps a werewolf via the robber; each team uses one agent version, Section 6.3 uses Gemini with temperature 1.0.

limits.zh: 固定夜间设置的讨论评测，不等于随机角色的完整游戏覆盖；不把三人 NashConv 实验与五人胜率混算。
limits.en: Discussion evaluation under fixed nights, not full random-role coverage; three-player NashConv is not pooled with five-player win rate.

label.zh: 十轮重复囚徒困境的行为轨迹

task.zh: 与对手反复选择合作或背叛，观察交流与互惠行为。
task.en: Repeatedly cooperate or defect against an opponent and assess communication and reciprocity.

observation.zh: 已发生的对局与交流历史；双方知道十轮时限。
observation.en: Available play and communication history with a known ten-round horizon.

action.zh: 轮前交流，然后选择合作或背叛。
action.en: Communicate before a round, then choose cooperation or defection.

metrics.zh: 动作轨迹的合作率、条件互惠、报复率、宽恕率与末轮背叛；不采用动机自报作为真值。
metrics.en: Action-based cooperation, conditional reciprocity, retaliation, forgiveness and end-game defection; self-reported motives are not ground truth.

controls.zh: 限定论文展示的十轮重复博弈，示例配对为 LLaMA 3.1 70B 与 GPT-4o。
controls.en: Restricted to the documented ten-round game; the example pairing is LLaMA 3.1 70B versus GPT-4o.

limits.zh: 不代表全部 24 个游戏；不合并存在配置歧义的评委打分。配对与重复次数须另行固定。
limits.en: Does not cover all 24 games or ambiguous judge-score configurations. Pairing and replication counts need explicit experimental settings.

basis.zh: 通过可观测合作与互惠轨迹检验社会互动，不推断内部动机。
basis.en: Observable cooperation and reciprocity trajectories measure social interaction without inferring internal motives.

task.en: Allocate a fixed troop budget across battlefields to win more battlefields.

observation.zh: 规则、固定预算和已完成回合的结果；本轮对手分配隐藏。
observation.en: Rules, fixed budget and completed-round outcomes; current opponent allocation is hidden.

action.zh: 同时提交各战场的兵力分配。

metrics.zh: 对局胜负/TrueSkill，另报非法输入和分配错误。
metrics.en: Match outcomes/TrueSkill, with invalid input and allocation errors reported separately.

controls.zh: 双人零和，无通信；一轮重试后连续非法动作可致终止；比赛阶段分开。
controls.en: Two-player zero-sum, no communication; one retry before consecutive invalid actions can terminate play; tournament stages separated.

limits.zh: 具体预算、战场数与轮数需绑定提交版本，不能从其他 Blotto 实现继承。
limits.en: Budget, battlefield count and round count must be tied to the submitted version rather than inherited from other Blotto implementations.

basis.zh: 隐蔽同时分配要求对手建模与资源取舍。
basis.en: Hidden simultaneous allocation requires opponent modeling and resource trade-offs.

task.zh: 间谍识别隐藏实体，非间谍通过问答发现间谍。
task.en: The spy identifies the hidden entity while non-spies identify the spy through questions.

observation.zh: 候选实体、角色私有信息与公开问答历史；间谍不见正确实体。
observation.en: Candidate entities, role-private information and public question history; the spy does not see the correct entity.

action.zh: 按阶段提问、回答、猜实体或投票，输出 JSON。
action.en: Issue phase-specific questions, answers, entity guesses or votes in JSON.

metrics.zh: 按角色和文化设置计算胜率及 Bradley–Terry 评分；格式失败单独处理。
metrics.en: Role/setting outcomes and Bradley–Terry ratings, with format failures handled separately.

controls.zh: 4 非间谍 + 1 间谍；前 5 轮问答、后 5 轮允许猜测和投票；角色排列与顺序控制。
controls.en: Four non-spies and one spy; five question rounds followed by five rounds permitting guesses and votes; role assignments and order controlled.

limits.zh: 仅核验该论文变体，非所有 Spyfall 规则；文化和语言知识影响成绩。
limits.en: Limited to this paper’s variant; cultural and linguistic knowledge affects performance.

label.zh: 五人政府组建与隐藏身份推断
label.en: Five-player government formation and hidden-role inference

task.zh: 通过政府投票与政策执行争取阵营胜利。
task.en: Win the faction game through government votes and policy enactment.

observation.zh: 公共政策/投票历史、私有角色与政策手牌、讨论消息。
observation.en: Public policy/vote history, private role and policy cards, and discussion messages.

action.zh: 提名总理、投票、丢弃/执行政策及阶段内发言。
action.en: Nominate a chancellor, vote, discard/enact policies and speak within phases.

metrics.zh: 阵营胜率、角色识别准确率、欺骗保持率、政府通过率及局势影响指标。
metrics.en: Faction win rate, role-identification accuracy, deception retention, government approval and game-state impact.

controls.zh: 3 自由派、1 法西斯、1 希特勒；政府投票前和政策后各一轮随机顺序发言；固定与替代对手设置分开。
controls.en: Three liberals, one fascist and Hitler; randomized discussion before voting and after policies; fixed and alternative opponents reported separately.

limits.zh: 角色推断与局势影响是论文定义的辅助指标；不等同一般心理能力。
limits.en: Role inference and game-state impact are paper-defined auxiliary metrics, not general psychological ability.

basis.zh: 隐藏身份、公开辩论和投票直接检验身份推断与欺骗。
basis.en: Hidden identities, public debate and voting directly test role inference and deception.

basis.zh: 政策和政府选择影响阵营终局。
basis.en: Policy and government decisions affect faction outcomes.

evidence.excerpt: Werewolves uses role-aware information and legal actions in a finite-state schedule with a forty-turn limit. Village wins by eliminating wolves; wolves win at parity. Tournament outcomes support role-conditioned win rates.

task.zh: 扮演村民阵营或狼人阵营，通过发言、投票与角色行动取得阵营胜利。
task.en: Play a village or wolf role through speech, voting and role actions to achieve a team win.

observation.zh: 公开消息与按角色授权的私有信息。
observation.en: Public messages and role-authorized private information.

action.zh: 按状态提供 JSON 动作类型及参数：发言、投票、夜间击杀或角色技能。
action.en: State-dependent JSON action types and arguments for speech, voting, night kills and role abilities.

metrics.zh: 阵营胜负、按角色统计胜率；锦标赛结果经 Bradley–Terry MLE 得到 Elo。
metrics.en: Team outcomes and role-conditioned win rates; tournament outcomes feed Bradley–Terry MLE Elo.

controls.zh: 有限状态调度；40 轮上限；村民消灭狼人获胜，狼人达到人数平衡获胜。
controls.en: Finite-state scheduling, forty-turn cap, village victory on eliminating wolves and wolf victory at parity.

limits.zh: 这里只接入狼人杀，不把协议或能力复制给其余 20 个游戏；角色、配对与调度必须一致，Elo 依赖对手池。
limits.en: Only Werewolves is included, without propagating its protocol to the other twenty games. Match roles and scheduling; Elo depends on the opponent pool.

basis.zh: 隐藏角色与发言/投票策略由角色条件胜率评估。
basis.en: Hidden-role speech and voting decisions are evaluated with role-conditioned win rates.

label.zh: 腐化通信下的阈值协作

task.zh: 在团队阈值收益条件下选择 STAG 或 HARE。
task.en: Choose STAG or HARE under threshold-dependent group payoffs.

observation.zh: 固定顺序的结构化公共历史与游戏规则。
observation.en: Structured public history in a fixed speaking order and game rules.

action.zh: 输出二元决策与理由；指定通道会翻转报告和执行动作。
action.en: Output a binary choice and justification; designated channels flip reported and executed actions.

metrics.zh: 原始 STAG 比例、翻转前成功率、实际成功率与福利差。

task.zh: 按数独约束在网格中放置数值，解决需要组合策略的难题。

observation.zh: 符号网格或由 MNIST 数字呈现的视觉线索网格。

action.zh: place(row, col, value)，由规则校验并更新状态。

metrics.zh: Hard 难度任务的成功率，关联正确形成和应用所需策略。

controls.zh: 以 Easy/Moderate 训练，以含未见策略组合的 Hard 测试。

limits.zh: 仅接入已明确交互接口的数独；试题数、种子及动作预算尚未逐项锁定，不把静态问答当游玩。

basis.zh: 测试要求组合训练阶段未共同出现的策略。
basis.en: Tests require combinations of strategies not jointly encountered in training.

label.zh: Snake 严格规则闭环控制

task.zh: 在避开墙壁、身体和障碍物的同时吃苹果。
task.en: Eat apples while avoiding walls, the snake body and obstacles.

observation.zh: 网格中的墙、蛇头、身体、食物、障碍物及当前方向。
observation.en: Grid walls, head, body, food, obstacles and current direction.

action.zh: LEFT、RIGHT、UP、DOWN 四个方向动作；禁止反向。
action.en: LEFT, RIGHT, UP and DOWN, with reversal prohibited.

metrics.zh: 每个苹果加一分并增长；报告环境得分及学习曲线 Avg、Max、AUC+。
metrics.en: Each apple adds one point and increases length; report environment scores and curve Avg, Max and AUC+.

controls.zh: 严格评测遇碰撞终止、上限 64 步；30 次探索，每 3 次探索评测 3 局，评测种子分离且不反馈结果。
controls.en: Strict collision termination with a sixty-four-step cap; thirty exploration episodes, three evaluation games every three episodes, disjoint seeds and no evaluation feedback.

limits.zh: 仅覆盖 Snake；探索时碰撞为 no-op 与严格评测不同，曲线汇总并非独立能力。
limits.en: Covers Snake only. Exploration collision no-ops differ from strict evaluation; curve aggregates are not separate capabilities.

basis.zh: 方向选择、避碰与得分直接检验闭环控制。
basis.en: Direction selection, collision avoidance and score directly assess closed-loop control.

basis.zh: 分离种子及更严格终止规则检验同一游戏内的转移。
basis.en: Disjoint seeds and stricter termination test within-game transfer.

evidence.title: S3Gym, Table 2 and Appendix A.4

records.noteZh: 保留34款共同评测协议，新增仅限 Game Cafe Escape 的依赖规划视图；未向其余33款传播规划标签。

task.zh: 完成各游戏指定里程碑或提升指定数值目标；两款Grim Tales只评初始找物场景。
task.en: Complete specified milestones or improve designated numeric goals; the two Grim Tales games evaluate initial hidden-object scenes only.

observation.zh: 游戏屏幕与近期轨迹，额外记忆依harness而定。
observation.en: Game screen and recent trajectories, with harness-dependent memory.

action.zh: GUI点击、键盘等原生游戏交互。
action.en: Native GUI clicks, keyboard inputs, and game interactions.

metrics.zh: 离散里程碑完成比例；六款连续数值目标按人类参考归一化；动作数另列。
metrics.en: Discrete milestone completion; six continuous-goal scores normalized against human references; action counts reported separately.

controls.zh: 每游戏固定目标及最大步数；近期10条轨迹；原文仅单次运行。
controls.en: Fixed per-game goals/action caps, latest ten trajectories; single runs in paper.

limits.zh: CUA-as-a-Judge存在判定误差；无严格反应时，不计即时控制代表性。 任务跨度不一，不能把完整故事线或记忆能力统一复制到34款。
limits.en: CUA-as-a-Judge may err; no strict reaction timing, so not representative real-time control. Heterogeneous task scopes do not justify copying full-story or memory labels to all thirty-four titles.

records.noteZh: 已核实50剧本竞技场的角色讨论、推理、最终投票与胜率，按互动社会推理纳入；感知QA和链式问答仍在游玩覆盖之外。
records.noteEn: Verified the fifty-script arena’s role discussion, reasoning, voting and win rate, integrating interactive social inference while excluding perception/chain QA.

evidence.title: WhodunitBench: Evaluating Large Multimodal Agents via Murder Mystery Games
evidence.excerpt: WhodunitBench separates perception QA, reasoning, role-play, and games; static QA is not complete social gameplay.

evidence.title: WhodunitBench: Evaluating Large Multimodal Agents via Murder Mystery Games
evidence.excerpt: Official sources distinguish interactive murder-mystery play from separate QA. The full paper and author repository were attempted, but complete role scheduling, round limits and interactive scoring rules remain unverified; QA accuracy is not gameplay ability.

evidence.title: WhodunitBench author repository
evidence.excerpt: The author repository identifies WhodunitBench; the accessed material did not establish a complete reusable interaction protocol.

evidence.title: WhodunitBench: Evaluating Large Multimodal Agents via Murder Mystery Games
evidence.excerpt: The arena uses fifty scripted scenarios, private/public multimodal clues, discussion, reasoning and final voting; win rate is distinct from static chain-of-evaluation QA.

evidence.title: WhodunitBench official repository
evidence.excerpt: The public data schema distinguishes role scripts, image/text clues, murderer identity and separate QA fields; the README documents arena launch.

basis.zh: 不完整身份信息、角色隐瞒及讨论投票是实际胜负机制。
basis.en: Incomplete identity information, concealment, discussion and voting determine outcomes.

task.zh: 在脚本场景中识别凶手，或作为凶手隐藏身份。
task.en: Identify the murderer, or conceal identity when playing the murderer.

observation.zh: 角色剧本、私有/公开文字线索、图像线索和讨论内容。
observation.en: Role scripts, private/public text clues, image clues and discussion.

action.zh: 以角色身份讨论，陈述嫌疑人及动机推理，最终投票。
action.en: Discuss in role, articulate suspect/motive reasoning, and cast a final vote.

metrics.zh: 竞技场胜率；静态感知问答与链式评估分数不并入游玩单元。
metrics.en: Arena win rate; static perception QA and chain-evaluation scores are excluded from the gameplay unit.

controls.zh: 论文50个剧本场景及相同基线对手；剧本、角色与对手须分层比较。
controls.en: Fifty scripted scenarios and the paper’s baseline opponent; compare by script, role and opponent.

limits.zh: 仍未核实全部剧本名称、逐阶段轮数和公开启动代码；保留套件级协议与部分核验状态。
limits.en: Full script names, per-phase round counts and public launch implementation remain unconfirmed; retain a partial suite-level protocol.

followup.noteZh: 官方来源明确同时包含谋杀谜案互动与独立问答。已再次尝试官方完整论文及作者仓库，但尚未获得可核实的完整角色调度、轮数和互动评分细则；不把问答准确率当互动能力。
followup.noteEn: Official sources distinguish interactive murder-mystery play from separate QA. The full paper and author repository were attempted, but complete role scheduling, round limits and interactive scoring rules remain unverified; QA accuracy is not gameplay ability.

sources.title: WhodunitBench: Evaluating Large Multimodal Agents via Murder Mystery Games
sources.excerpt: Official full-paper access attempted; full text unavailable during this review. Complete scheduling and interactive-scoring rules remain unverified.

sources.title: WhodunitBench author repository
sources.excerpt: The author repository identifies WhodunitBench; the accessed material did not establish a complete reusable interaction protocol.

reviewedScope.zh: 50剧本互动竞技场共同协议
reviewedScope.en: Shared interactive arena protocol over fifty scripts

integrationReview.noteZh: 互动谜案和独立问答已区分；当前来源尚未支持明确的角色行动调度与互动成功评分，不用问答准确率填补缺项。
integrationReview.noteEn: Interactive mysteries are distinguished from separate QA, but role action scheduling and interactive success scoring remain unestablished. QA accuracy does not fill these gaps.

sources.title: WhodunitBench: Evaluating Large Multimodal Agents via Murder Mystery Games

basis.zh: 已核实50剧本竞技场的角色讨论、推理、最终投票与胜率，按互动社会推理纳入；感知QA和链式问答仍在游玩覆盖之外。
basis.en: Verified the fifty-script arena’s role discussion, reasoning, voting and win rate, integrating interactive social inference while excluding perception/chain QA.

protocolFollowup.noteZh: 已核实50剧本竞技场的角色讨论、推理、最终投票与胜率，按互动社会推理纳入；感知QA和链式问答仍在游玩覆盖之外。
protocolFollowup.noteEn: Verified the fifty-script arena’s role discussion, reasoning, voting and win rate, integrating interactive social inference while excluding perception/chain QA.

detail.zh: 完整剧本名称及逐剧本角色/轮次清单未核实。
detail.en: Complete script names and per-script roles/rounds remain unverified.

detail.zh: 公开README所列启动代码尚未在公开目录中核实。
detail.en: The launcher named by the public README was not verified in the public tree.

sources.title: WhodunitBench: Evaluating Large Multimodal Agents via Murder Mystery Games
sources.excerpt: The arena uses fifty scripted scenarios, private/public multimodal clues, discussion, reasoning and final voting; win rate is distinct from static chain-of-evaluation QA.

sources.title: WhodunitBench official repository
sources.excerpt: The public data schema distinguishes role scripts, image/text clues, murderer identity and separate QA fields; the README documents arena launch.

records.noteEn: The task description specifies three guesses, taboo-word validation and 100/n speed scoring. The added protocol is limited to this two-player game. Routing review: Route clembench’s constrained clue-and-guess dialogue variant, not all commercial Taboo rules or other dialogue games.

task.zh: 描述者避免目标词及禁词，帮助猜词者识别目标。
task.en: A describer avoids the target and forbidden words while helping a guesser identify the concept.

observation.zh: 描述者见目标和禁词；猜词者只见合法描述与对话。
observation.en: The describer sees the target and taboo words; the guesser sees valid descriptions and dialogue.

action.zh: 生成描述或目标词猜测。
action.en: Generate a description or a target-word guess.

metrics.zh: 有效进行比例、成功时 100/n 的速度分及两者组合的 clemscore。
metrics.en: Played ratio, successful speed score 100/n, and their combined clemscore.

controls.zh: 最多三轮猜词；Game Master 严格解析并检查禁词。
controls.en: At most three guessing rounds; the Game Master strictly parses outputs and checks forbidden words.

limits.zh: 分数主要评估配对而非独立角色；格式失败与任务失败需区分。
limits.en: Scores mainly evaluate the pair, not isolated roles; format failure differs from task failure.

basis.zh: 私有目标必须通过受限语言传递给另一玩家。
basis.en: A private target must be communicated to another player through constrained language.

evidence.title: clembench: Using Game Play to Evaluate Chat-Optimized Language Models as Conversational Agents
evidence.excerpt: The task description specifies three guesses, taboo-word validation and 100/n speed scoring. The added protocol is limited to this two-player game.

evidence.title: clembench: Using Game Play to Evaluate Chat-Optimized Language Models as Conversational Agents
evidence.excerpt: The Taboo dialogue task pairs a constrained description player with a guesser and validates forbidden words and guesses.

records.noteZh: 保留30款测试游戏的叙事选择、成就与伤害协议。当前论文的伦理伤害、权力指标和当前场景提示，不足以将某个具体游戏映射到11条能力轴；不把伦理评价当社会推理。
records.noteEn: Preserved narrative choice, achievement and harm evaluation for thirty test games. Ethical-harm/power metrics and current-scene prompts do not establish a specific game’s eleven-axis capability; ethics is not treated as social inference.

evidence.title: Do the Rewards Justify the Means? Measuring Trade-Offs Between Rewards and Ethical Behavior in the Machiavelli Benchmark
evidence.excerpt: Machiavelli evaluates adventure rewards against ethical behavior; automated ethics labels are not collaboration scores.

evidence.title: Do the Rewards Justify the Means? Measuring Trade-Offs Between Rewards and Ethical Behavior in the Machiavelli Benchmark
evidence.excerpt: Appendices G/H/I specify the 30-game test set, current-scene-only LM prompts and 50k-step RL training/checkpoint selection. Ethical harm metrics remain separate from the nine gameplay dimensions.

evidence.title: Do the Rewards Justify the Means? Measuring Trade-Offs Between Rewards and Ethical Behavior in the Machiavelli Benchmark
evidence.excerpt: The thirty-game protocol measures achievements and annotated harm; current-scene LM prompts and ethical metrics alone do not establish a particular eleven-axis subtask.

task.zh: 从场景提供的选项中行动以获取目标成就，并记录行为伤害。
task.en: Choose provided actions to earn target achievements while recording behavioral harms.

observation.zh: 当前场景、合法选项、目标成就状态；基线 LM 不保留完整历史。
observation.en: Current scene, available choices and target achievement status; baseline LMs do not retain full history.

action.zh: 输出选项整数编号；CoT 版本附带推理。
action.en: Output an integer choice index, with reasoning in the CoT variant.

metrics.zh: 归一化成就奖励；伤害相对 1000 条随机轨迹均值归一化。
metrics.en: Normalized achievement reward; harm normalized against 1,000 random trajectories.

controls.zh: 134 游戏资源中的 30 测试游戏；RL 每游戏训练 50k 步选最高训练分；提示变体分开。
controls.en: Thirty test games from the 134-game resource; per-game RL training for 50k steps with best-training-score selection; prompt variants separated.

limits.zh: 伤害来自场景标注；当前场景提示不支持据此声称历史记忆测试。
limits.en: Harms depend on scene annotations; current-scene prompts do not establish a historical-memory test.

evidence.title: Do the Rewards Justify the Means? Measuring Trade-Offs Between Rewards and Ethical Behavior in the Machiavelli Benchmark
evidence.excerpt: Appendices G/H/I specify the 30-game test set, current-scene-only LM prompts and 50k-step RL training/checkpoint selection. Ethical harm metrics remain separate from the nine gameplay dimensions.

evidence.title: Do the Rewards Justify the Means? Measuring Trade-Offs Between Rewards and Ethical Behavior in the Machiavelli Benchmark
evidence.excerpt: Appendix G explicitly lists the thirty-game test subset from the 134-game resource; achievement and ethical-harm evaluation uses this subset.

findings.en: Route only the thirty test games in Appendix G. Capability mapping remains absent because achievement/harm metrics do not isolate per-game planning, memory or social skills.

basis.zh: 保留30款测试游戏的叙事选择、成就与伤害协议。当前论文的伦理伤害、权力指标和当前场景提示，不足以将某个具体游戏映射到11条能力轴；不把伦理评价当社会推理。
basis.en: Preserved narrative choice, achievement and harm evaluation for thirty test games. Ethical-harm/power metrics and current-scene prompts do not establish a specific game’s eleven-axis capability; ethics is not treated as social inference.

detail.zh: 缺少某个具体游戏/成就的可核对任务机制及其与11轴的对应依据；已有总奖励和伦理指标不能替代。
detail.en: A concrete game/achievement mechanism and traceable mapping to an eleven-axis construct are still needed; aggregate rewards and ethics metrics are insufficient.

task.zh: 探索未到访房间，并完成游戏目标以累积得分。
task.en: Visit new rooms and accomplish game objectives to accumulate score.

controls.zh: 继承原单游戏 DRRN/TDQN 设置，仅限定到表1的 Deephome。

limits.zh: 总分不是纯探索指标；额外房间奖励可能不要求完成故事；有效动作辅助仍适用。

sources.title: VISTA: A Visual Harness for Reasoning in an Interactive World
sources.excerpt: Section 4 evaluates twenty-five public ARC-AGI-3 games with undisclosed rules/goals, image observations, available actions, level completion and relative human action efficiency.

records.noteZh: 核验隐藏规则路径任务及规则保留测试；不把规则记事本当成独立记忆能力证明。 本轮归属复核：主结果基于17个私有测试游戏，另有8个公开验证游戏；保留共同协议，不能用训练/验证示例替代私有测试成员。

action.zh: 四向移动、SUBMIT、RESET；每调用最多 16 动作。

metrics.zh: RHAE-L5/L20、完成关卡数、相对最优动作效率。
metrics.en: RHAE-L5/L20, solved levels and optimal-action efficiency.

controls.zh: 每关 300 动作、每游戏 1,000 调用；测试 5 种子，验证 3 种子；区分提供规则的消融。
controls.en: 300 actions per level, 1,000 calls per game; 5 test and 3 validation seeds; separate rule-revealed ablation.

limits.zh: 17 个私有测试游戏不应复制到四个公开示例；失败可能来自解析、发现或执行。

task.zh: 为每个目标一次生成可执行路径，并继续到下个目标
task.en: Generate an executable route per target and continue from the resulting position

observation.zh: 文本地图、当前位置、目标坐标、地块说明与已有奖励

action.en: Output a movement sequence

metrics.zh: GTB-Score、Top-0/1/5准确率、路径长、动作数、生成错误数
metrics.en: GTB-Score, Top-0/1/5 accuracy, path length, action count and generation errors

controls.en: 150 maps, three seeds in main table; up to ten formatting attempts per target; separate no-feedback and one-feedback modes

limits.en: Score mixes format errors and path costs, rather than isolated reasoning

basis.en: Routes through obstacles are evaluated against A* distances

label.zh: Sokoban / RealSokoban 空间推箱规划

task.zh: 根据墙、箱子和目标的位置安排推动顺序，避免不可逆死锁并完成推箱目标。
task.en: Plan pushes from wall, box and goal positions, avoid irreversible deadlocks and solve the box-pushing level.

observation.zh: ASCII状态、实体映射、目标、动作映射；默认不含过去状态动作
observation.en: ASCII state, entity/goal/action mappings; no past states/actions by default

action.en: Choose one engine-permitted discrete action per step

metrics.zh: 两款各自的胜率、归一化奖励、有效动作比例和步效率；不将共同综合分解释为独立规划分。
metrics.en: Per-game win rate, normalized reward, meaningful-step ratio and efficiency; aggregate scores are not independent planning scores.

controls.zh: 分开程序生成Sokoban与人工XSokoban关卡的RealSokoban；九LLM零样本/上下文提示条件分开，沿用原文逐关卡重复与统计区间。
controls.en: Separate procedurally generated Sokoban from RealSokoban’s human-designed XSokoban levels; keep nine-model zero-shot/contextual settings and the paper’s per-level repetitions/intervals separate.

limits.zh: 仅两种GVGAI推箱实现；空间与规划是规则和死锁机制支持的编辑归类，成功率也受状态识别与动作格式影响；不复制给其他116款。
limits.en: Only the two GVGAI box-pushing implementations. Spatial/planning labels are editorial classifications grounded in rules and deadlocks; perception/formatting also affect success. Other 116 games do not inherit them.

basis.zh: 表3将二者列为空间谜题；需要推断箱、墙、目标的相对位置和移动可达性。
basis.en: Table 3 identifies both as spatial puzzles requiring reasoning about box/wall/goal relations and movement feasibility.

basis.zh: §4.2明确不可逆移动和死锁要求多步推箱次序，人工RealSokoban通常规划更长。
basis.en: Section 4.2 describes irreversible moves and deadlock-sensitive push ordering, with longer planning demands in human-designed RealSokoban.

evidence.title: GVGAI-LLM: Evaluating Large Language Model Agents with Infinite Games

findings.zh: 具体关联六游戏跨模型子集，GVGAI的Zelda/Sokoban等实现与原版分开。118游戏初筛未作为同等跨模型覆盖；共同单位不统一赋能力，另提取推箱子空间规划子任务。
findings.en: Route the six-game cross-model subset as distinct GVGAI implementations. The 118-game preliminary sweep is not equivalent cross-model coverage; the shared unit remains unlabelled, with box-pushing spatial planning extracted separately.

reviewedScope.zh: 六游戏跨模型共同协议；明确补充两种推箱实现的空间规划单位。118游戏初筛不等同全部逐能力核验。
reviewedScope.en: Six-game cross-model common protocol plus spatial-planning evaluation in the two box-pushing implementations; the 118-game sweep is not exhaustive capability verification.

basis.zh: 核验118游戏的文本状态交互与行为指标；每步不提供历史，因此不把该默认设置标成记忆评测。 本轮归属复核：具体关联六游戏跨模型子集，GVGAI的Zelda/Sokoban等实现与原版分开。118游戏初筛未作为同等跨模型覆盖；共同单位不统一赋能力，另提取推箱子空间规划子任务。
basis.en: Verified textual interaction and behavior metrics across 118 games; the default per-step setup supplies no history and is not labelled a memory evaluation. Routing review: Route the six-game cross-model subset as distinct GVGAI implementations. The 118-game preliminary sweep is not equivalent cross-model coverage; the shared unit remains unlabelled, with box-pushing spatial planning extracted separately.

basis.zh: 重新核对控制实验与世界模型诊断的区分：Atari100k、Crafter、五个 ViZDoom 场景为闭环回报，MiniGrid 的预测一致性实验不计记忆操控能力。既有任务范围保持，训练曲线不是逐模型统一试玩协议。 本轮归属复核：严格按表1的26款Atari 100k实际结果关联；不纳入未评测的ALE游戏。

records.noteZh: 完整论文区分 Atari100k 策略评估与 CS:GO 交互生成演示。前者以真实交互预算、逐游戏回报/人类归一化分评价；后者没有可替代原游戏对战胜率的评测，继续只保留 Atari 单位。 本轮归属复核：严格按表1的26款Atari 100k实际结果关联；不纳入未评测的ALE游戏。
records.noteEn: The full paper separates Atari100k policy evaluation from interactive CS:GO generation. Real-interaction budgets and game/human-normalized returns apply to Atari; CS:GO generation does not supply native-match wins. Routing review: Route exactly the twenty-six Atari 100k result rows in Table 1, excluding unevaluated ALE games.

label.zh: Craftax 生存与地下城进展

task.zh: 维持生存资源，制作工具、战斗并逐层推进地下城。
task.en: Maintain survival resources, craft tools, fight and progress through dungeon floors.

observation.zh: 局部符号地图、物品栏、生存资源和楼层状态。
observation.en: Local symbolic map, inventory, intrinsic resources and floor indicators.

action.zh: 移动、交互、制作、装备与上下楼等环境离散动作。
action.en: Discrete movement, interaction, crafting, equipment and floor traversal.

metrics.zh: 官方轨道以累计奖励占最大值 226 的百分比报告。
metrics.en: Official tracks report cumulative reward as a percentage of 226.

controls.zh: 分别记录 1M 与 1B 交互预算；固定版本、观测及重置设置。
controls.en: Keep 1M and 1B interaction tracks separate; fix version, observations and resets.

limits.zh: 综合奖励不分离单项能力；该节点也含 Classic 名称，但本单位仅适用于扩展 Craftax。
limits.en: Aggregate reward does not isolate abilities; this unit applies only to extended Craftax despite the combined index label.

basis.zh: 工具制作存在木材、石材、铁矿等先决依赖。
basis.en: Crafting has resource and tool prerequisites.

basis.zh: 必须发现资源和通往下一层的入口。
basis.en: Resources and exits must be discovered.

task.en: Agents with different materials construct a blueprint, respecting support dependencies.

observation.zh: 目标三视图、语言指令、各自第一人称 RGB 与物品栏。
observation.en: Orthographic goals, instructions, first-person RGB and inventory.

action.zh: 带 Agent、物品和三维坐标参数的高级技能。
action.en: High-level skills parameterized by agent, item and 3D position.

metrics.zh: 整体成功率、已完成目标块比例、重复/冲突动作比例。
metrics.en: Task success, completed-block fraction and redundant/conflicting-action rate.

controls.zh: 区分集中/分散控制；标准测试 50 例，另分目标、场景和四 Agent 留出条件。
controls.en: Separate centralized/decentralized control; 50 standard cases plus held-out goals, scenes and four-agent cases.

limits.zh: 高级技能执行屏蔽部分低层操作；不是 Minecraft 全流程任务。
limits.en: High-level execution abstracts low-level control; not full Minecraft play.

basis.zh: 不同材料与支撑依赖要求团队分工。
basis.en: Different inventories and support dependencies require division of labor.

basis.zh: 从二维三视图恢复三维结构和放置坐标。
basis.en: Reconstruct 3D structures and placement coordinates from orthographic views.

basis.zh: 目标、场景和团队人数有明确留出条件。
basis.en: Explicit held-out goal, scene and team-size conditions.

action.en: 17 discrete movement, interaction, sleep, placement and crafting actions.

metrics.zh: 22 项成就在训练回合中的成功率，以及几何均值 Crafter score。
metrics.en: 22 achievement success rates across training episodes and geometric-mean Crafter score.

controls.zh: 标准 RL/无监督轨道 1M 环境步；外部知识轨道分开。
controls.en: 1M environment steps for standard RL/unsupervised tracks; external-knowledge track separate.

limits.zh: 成就综合分并不隔离能力；随机世界不自动等于严格 OOD 测试。
limits.en: Aggregate achievements do not isolate abilities; random worlds are not automatically strict OOD testing.

basis.zh: 发现材料和解锁新成就是评价对象。
basis.en: Resource discovery and novel achievements drive evaluation.

basis.zh: 高级工具需要前序材料和制作步骤。
basis.en: Advanced tools depend on earlier resources and crafting steps.

basis.zh: 生存维持与多阶段成就需在同一回合持续推进。
basis.en: Survival and multi-stage achievements require sustained within-episode progress.

records.noteZh: 代码确认河流、巨石、终点和预算；任务可纳入文献图，训练种子与算法比较设置需另行固定。
records.noteEn: Code confirms river, boulders, goal and budget; training seeds and comparative algorithm settings still need fixing.

task.zh: 安排巨石并跨越河流障碍，到达对岸终点。
task.en: Arrange boulders to cross the river barrier and reach the far goal.

observation.zh: NetHack glyph 地图、局部裁剪、状态和消息；可配置观测。
observation.en: Configurable NetHack glyph map/crop, status and messages.

action.zh: 导航移动及通过移动推动巨石。
action.en: Navigation movements, including pushing boulders through movement.

metrics.zh: 达到终点的成功率；默认终点奖励 1，失败 0。
metrics.en: Goal-reaching success; default terminal rewards are 1 for success and 0 for failure.

controls.zh: 标准 River 默认 350 步、5 块巨石；不混入 Lava/Monster 变体。
controls.en: Default River: 350 steps and five boulders; separate Lava/Monster variants.

limits.zh: 仅证明空间操作和动作顺序需求，未固定 OOD 划分。
limits.en: Establishes spatial manipulation and sequencing demands, without a pinned OOD split.

basis.en: Boulder-pushing order determines a viable route.

basis.zh: 需结合河宽、巨石位置和目标选择路线。
basis.en: Route choice depends on river width, boulder locations and goal.

records.noteZh: 仅展开一个有明确收益、代价、输入和动作协议的安全 RL 场景。
records.noteEn: Expands one safe-RL scenario with explicit reward, cost, inputs and actions.

task.zh: 收集武器并送回起点，平衡收益、负重和返程时机。
task.en: Collect weapons and return them, balancing reward, load and return timing.

observation.zh: 160×120 第一人称 RGB，含 HUD；90° 水平视野。
observation.en: 160×120 egocentric RGB with HUD and 90-degree horizontal field of view.

action.zh: 简化动作：前进、左右转、使用、跳跃。
action.en: Simplified forward, left/right turn, use and jump actions.

metrics.zh: 武器交付回报与累计超载代价，按安全阈值约束比较。
metrics.en: Delivery return and cumulative overload cost under a safety threshold.

controls.zh: 随机初态、最多 2,100 ticks；固定难度、代价预算和动作版本。
controls.en: Random starts, up to 2,100 ticks; fix difficulty, cost budget and action variant.

limits.zh: 安全代价需独立展示；高回报不意味着安全，不能替代完整 FPS 能力。
limits.en: Display safety cost separately; high return is not safety or complete FPS ability.

basis.zh: 高价值重武器与负重惩罚形成明确取舍。
basis.en: Valuable heavy weapons trade off against load penalties.

basis.zh: 采集顺序与返回时间影响是否成功交付。
basis.en: Collection order and return timing affect delivery.

reviewedScope.en: Kinetix zero-shot physics control from generated training to handmade holdouts.

records.noteZh: 采用原论文符号实体、多离散动作与 holdout solve rate；未将所有物理关卡都标为记忆。
records.noteEn: Uses symbolic entities, multi-discrete actions and holdout solve rate; fully observed physics tasks are not labeled memory tests.

task.zh: 控制电机和推进器，使绿色物体接触蓝色目标，避免红色碰撞。
task.en: Control motors/thrusters to bring green into blue while avoiding red.

observation.zh: 完整实体物理属性，包括位置、旋转、速度与连接关系。
observation.en: Fully observed entity properties, positions, rotations, velocities and connections.

action.zh: 每个电机的正转/反转/关闭及推进器开/关。
action.en: Per-motor forward/reverse/off and thruster on/off.

metrics.zh: 手工留出关卡成功率；成功 +1、失败碰撞 −1。
metrics.en: Solve rate on handmade holdouts; success +1 and forbidden collision −1.

controls.zh: 按 S/M/L 分组；训练 5B 交互、5 个种子；手工关卡不参与训练。
controls.en: Separate S/M/L sizes; 5B interactions and five seeds; handmade levels excluded from training.

limits.zh: 留出关卡仍处于训练分布支持内；不同关卡不自动拥有全部能力。
limits.en: Holdouts remain within training-distribution support; do not inherit every ability to each level.

basis.zh: 随机关卡训练后测试未见手工关卡。
basis.en: Tests unseen handmade levels after generated-level training.

basis.zh: 逐步驱动电机和推进器完成碰撞目标。
basis.en: Stepwise motor/thruster actuation achieves the contact goal.

label.zh: Doom II 关卡检查点推进

task.zh: 从画面判断情况并操作游戏，推进预设关卡检查点。
task.en: Operate from visual observations and advance predefined level checkpoints.

observation.zh: 原始屏幕帧与目标/操作说明；无 RAM、解析状态或中间奖励。
observation.en: Raw frames and objective/control instructions; no RAM, parsed state or intermediate rewards.

action.zh: 语言接口输出按键、按键序列及持续时间。
action.en: Language interface emits buttons, sequences and durations.

metrics.zh: 到达检查点占该游戏全部检查点的比例。
metrics.en: Fraction of the game's predefined checkpoints reached.

controls.zh: 固定起点、游戏时限和重启规则；区分持续运行与推理时暂停的 Lite。
controls.en: Fix start, time cap and restart rules; distinguish real-time running from paused-inference Lite.

limits.zh: Doom II 的具体时限/检查点清单需随发布配置锁定；Lite 不测相同实时延迟约束。
limits.en: Pin Doom II's exact cap/checkpoint list to the release; Lite removes real-time inference pressure.

basis.zh: 动作持续时间、瞄准与移动直接影响关卡推进。
basis.en: Action timing, aiming and movement directly affect level progression.

metrics.en: Kill count or survival frames, averaged over five runs.

limits.zh: 障碍和敌人类型同时改变动力学，不能视为纯视觉不变性测试。
limits.en: Obstacles and enemy types also alter dynamics; this is not pure visual invariance.

basis.zh: 测试明确排除训练中的高修改等级。
basis.en: Higher modification levels are explicitly held out.

basis.zh: 击杀/存活指标依赖实时射击或躲避控制。
basis.en: Kill/survival metrics depend on shooting or evasion control.

observation.zh: 资源、建筑、敌情等文本状态与历史摘要。

action.zh: 生产单位、建造、科技研究等文本宏动作，执行器调度。

metrics.en: Wins/games by difficulty and prompt; API calls/time separately.

controls.zh: 固定种族、对手难度、地图、提示和 CoS 汇总频率。
controls.en: Fix races, opponent difficulty, map, prompt and CoS frequency.

limits.en: Unequal game counts and TBD cells; macro play does not establish pixel microcontrol or multi-agent coordination.

basis.zh: 完整对局需要经济、兵种和攻防取舍。
basis.en: Full games require economic, composition and attack/defense tradeoffs.

basis.zh: 生产与科技路径存在前置依赖。
basis.en: Production and technology paths have prerequisites.

basis.zh: 目标跨整局维持并随对手调整。
basis.en: Objectives must persist and adapt throughout a full game.

label.en: Repeated target retrieval in a fixed maze

task.en: Repeatedly reach color-cued targets in an episode with fixed layout and object positions.

observation.zh: 64×64 第一人称 RGB；边框颜色提示目标。
observation.en: 64×64 first-person RGB with target color indicated by the border.

action.zh: 6 个离散动作：空动作、前进、左右转及前进转向。
action.en: Six actions: no-op, forward, turns and combined forward-turns.

metrics.zh: 每正确触碰目标 +1，总回报等于目标到达数。
metrics.en: Each correct target gives +1; return equals targets reached.

controls.en: 9/11/13/15 mazes use 1,000/2,000/3,000/4,000 steps; exclude privileged ExtraObs.

limits.zh: 这是空间记忆与导航，不代表语言记忆；需区分尺寸分组。
limits.en: Measures spatial memory/navigation, not language memory; separate size groups.

basis.zh: 已见目标位置与地图需要跨多次目标切换保留。
basis.en: Previously seen targets and layout must persist across target changes.

basis.zh: 根据自身位置与已知布局返回目标。
basis.en: Return to targets using self-location and learned layout.

action.en: Discrete movement, turn, clean and zap actions.

metrics.en: Focal per-capita return; contest score normalized to baseline best/worst returns.

limits.zh: 只展开 Clean Up；当前公开配置不宣称等同隐藏最终测试。高分不自动证明亲社会性。
limits.en: Only Clean Up is expanded; current public configs are not the hidden final test. High score is not automatically prosociality.

basis.en: Evaluates adaptation to co-player populations not seen in training.

basis.zh: 清理公共资源与个人采集之间的社会困境。
basis.en: Public cleaning and private harvesting create a social dilemma.

task.en: Sustain harvestable resources by maintaining the river while adapting to unfamiliar partners.

observation.en: Individual local pixels and rewards, not full global state.

action.en: Movement, turning, harvesting and river-cleaning interactions.

metrics.zh: 仅焦点群体的人均累计回报，排除背景 Agent；按测试场景报告。
metrics.en: Focal per-capita return excluding background agents, reported by scenario.

task.zh: 翻开牌并匹配点数或颜色，利用先前见过的位置。
task.en: Reveal and match ranks or colors using previously seen positions.

observation.zh: 牌位数组：只显示已匹配或当前翻开的值，其余隐藏。

metrics.en: Normalized match reward with failure/already-open penalties; aggregate return.

controls.zh: 固定牌组数、匹配类型、洗牌种子和由牌数决定的 episode_length。

action.en: 18 joystick/button combinations; action selection every five frames in the paper.

metrics.zh: 500 个不学习的评估回合平均分，再对 30 次试验汇总。
metrics.en: Mean score over 500 non-learning evaluation episodes, aggregated across 30 trials.

label.zh: SMAC 分散执行的协作微操

task.zh: 每个智能体控制一个作战单位，协同击败内置敌军；使用论文 14 个微操场景。
task.en: Each agent controls one unit and cooperates to defeat built-in enemies across the paper’s 14 micromanagement scenarios.

observation.zh: 单位视野内队友/敌军相对位置、生命、护盾与类型等局部特征；全局状态仅供集中训练。
observation.en: Local allied/enemy relative positions, health, shields and types within sight; global state is available only for centralized training.

action.zh: 四方向移动、按敌军 ID 攻击、停止；医疗运输机治疗队友；死亡单位 no-op。
action.en: Move in four directions, attack an enemy ID or stop; Medivacs heal allies; dead units use no-op.

metrics.zh: 在场景时限内击败所有敌人的 test win rate；训练曲线汇总中位数。
metrics.en: Test win rate for defeating every enemy within the scenario limit; training curves report medians.

controls.zh: 每 10,000 训练时间步暂停，运行 32 个贪心分散执行测试回合；固定场景、奖励设置与 SC2 版本。
controls.en: Pause every 10,000 training timesteps for 32 greedy decentralized test episodes; fix scenario, reward settings and SC2 version.

limits.zh: 仅微操战斗，不包含全局经济运营、建筑发展或语言沟通；训练使用的密集奖励与最终胜率需区分。
limits.en: Combat micromanagement only; no full-game economy, construction or language communication; shaped training rewards differ from evaluation win rate.

basis.zh: 单位必须在局部观测和分散执行下协同集火、走位或治疗。
basis.en: Units coordinate targeting, positioning or healing under local observations and decentralized execution.

basis.zh: 移动与攻击距离、冷却和走位共同影响战斗结果。
basis.en: Movement, attack range, cooldowns and positioning affect combat outcome.
