evidence.title: StarCraft II: A New Challenge for Reinforcement Learning
evidence.excerpt: Sections 3.4 and 4.4 describe BuildMarines: gather resources, build supply depots and barracks, then train marines. Agents use feature layers and function/argument actions; the baselines act every eight game steps.

task.zh: 从有限基地出发采集资源、建补给站和兵营，在时限内生产尽可能多的陆战队员。
task.en: Start from a limited base, gather resources, build supply depots and barracks, and produce as many marines as possible within the limit.

observation.zh: 屏幕和小地图特征层及资源、可用动作等非空间信息。
observation.en: Screen/minimap feature layers plus nonspatial features such as resources and available actions.

action.zh: 受限 PySC2 函数动作及空间参数：选择工人/建筑、采集、建造、训练。
action.en: Restricted PySC2 function actions and spatial arguments: select workers/buildings, gather, construct and train.

metrics.zh: BuildMarines 小游戏得分，即生产陆战队员的任务奖励/数量。
metrics.en: BuildMarines game score, reflecting reward/count for trained marines.

controls.zh: 固定小游戏时限和最小任务动作集；原论文 A3C 每 8 游戏步决策，实验训练 600M agent steps。
controls.en: Fixed mini-game time limit and minimal task action set; original A3C acts every eight game steps and trains for 600M agent steps.

limits.zh: 这是依赖规划的小游戏单元测试，不是全局 StarCraft II 胜率或多人协作；具体地图版本与运行预算应随实验配置记录。
limits.en: A dependency-planning mini-game unit test, not full StarCraft II win rate or multi-agent cooperation; map version and run budgets must accompany experiments.

basis.zh: 生产陆战队员需要遵循资源、补给和兵营的前置依赖。
basis.en: Producing marines requires resource, supply and barracks prerequisites.

evidence.title: StarCraft II: A New Challenge for Reinforcement Learning
evidence.excerpt: Sections 3.4 and 4.4 describe BuildMarines: gather resources, build supply depots and barracks, then train marines. Agents use feature layers and function/argument actions; the baselines act every eight game steps.

basis.zh: 从平台的实际小游戏评估中接入 BuildMarines；没有把人类回放预测作为游玩任务。
basis.en: Registered BuildMarines from the platform’s interactive mini-game evaluation, excluding replay prediction.

records.noteZh: 接入有明确成功判定的指令执行协议，空间关系依据来自 PutNextLocal。
records.noteEn: Registered instruction execution with explicit success criteria; spatial-reasoning attribution comes from PutNextLocal.

reviewedScope.zh: PutNextLocal 与 BossLevel 指令执行及共同接口。
reviewedScope.en: PutNextLocal and BossLevel instruction execution and shared interface.

evidence.title: BabyAI: A Platform to Study the Sample Efficiency of Grounded Language Learning
evidence.excerpt: Figure 1, learning experiments and Appendix B specify PutNextLocal/BossLevel instruction execution, egocentric 7×7 symbolic observations, seven actions and success/sample-efficiency metrics.

label.en: BabyAI: relational placement and composite instructions

task.zh: 执行 PutNextLocal 的物体相邻放置指令及 BossLevel 的多步组合指令，包含拾取、开门与到达。
task.en: Execute PutNextLocal object-adjacency instructions and BossLevel composite instructions involving pickup, opening doors and reaching objects.

observation.zh: 指令文本与朝向前方的 7×7×3 符号格子观测；墙和关闭的门遮挡视野。
observation.en: Instruction text and forward-facing 7×7×3 symbolic grid observations; walls and closed doors occlude visibility.

action.zh: 左/右转、前进、拾取、放下、toggle、done。
action.en: Turn left/right, move forward, pick up, drop, toggle and done.

metrics.zh: 指令完成成功率；达到至少 99% 成功率所需示范数或 RL 回合数衡量样本效率。
metrics.en: Instruction success rate; demonstrations or RL episodes needed to reach at least 99% success measure sample efficiency.

controls.zh: 使用生成器指定关卡和任务步数上限；论文验证使用 512 回合；奖励随成功所用步数折扣。
controls.en: Use the specified level generator and mission step limit; paper validation uses 512 episodes; successful reward decreases with steps used.

limits.zh: 合成语言和符号观测；不证明自然语言开放世界泛化。这里只有两个指令任务族，不能替代全部 BabyAI 关卡。
limits.en: Synthetic language and symbolic observations do not establish natural-language open-world generalization; only two task families are registered.

basis.zh: 复合指令涉及顺序约束、钥匙/门前置条件和目标分解。
basis.en: Composite instructions require ordering constraints, key/door prerequisites and goal decomposition.

basis.zh: PutNextLocal 必须使指定物体形成相邻关系。
basis.en: PutNextLocal requires a specified adjacency relation between objects.

evidence.title: BabyAI: A Platform to Study the Sample Efficiency of Grounded Language Learning
evidence.excerpt: Figure 1, learning experiments and Appendix B specify PutNextLocal/BossLevel instruction execution, egocentric 7×7 symbolic observations, seven actions and success/sample-efficiency metrics.

basis.zh: 接入有明确成功判定的指令执行协议，空间关系依据来自 PutNextLocal。
basis.en: Registered instruction execution with explicit success criteria; spatial-reasoning attribution comes from PutNextLocal.

records.noteZh: 已确认 Leduc 的实际策略学习与评估协议；保留平台代表任务身份，未核验全部 OpenSpiel 游戏。
records.noteEn: Confirmed actual Leduc policy learning/evaluation while retaining its status as a representative platform task; not all OpenSpiel games reviewed.

reviewedScope.zh: 原论文图 3–4 的双人 Leduc Poker。
reviewedScope.en: Two-player Leduc Poker in Figures 3–4 of the original paper.

evidence.title: OpenSpiel: A Framework for Reinforcement Learning in Games
evidence.excerpt: Sections 3.1–3.3 and Figures 3–4 report two-player Leduc poker policy learning and exploitability/NashConv in chips; these are concrete examples rather than a single platform-wide score.

label.zh: OpenSpiel：双人 Leduc Poker 策略评估
label.en: OpenSpiel: two-player Leduc Poker policy evaluation

task.zh: 在部分信息牌局中通过自博弈学习下注策略，并评估策略偏离均衡的程度。
task.en: Learn betting policies by self-play in imperfect-information poker and evaluate departure from equilibrium.

observation.zh: 玩家的信息状态，包括自己的私人牌与可观察的公共下注/发牌历史；不读取对手私人牌。
observation.en: Player information states include private cards and observable public betting/dealing history, excluding opponents’ private cards.

action.zh: 从当前合法的牌局动作中选择下注、跟注/过牌或弃牌等。
action.en: Choose from currently legal poker actions such as betting, calling/checking and folding.

metrics.zh: Exploitability 或 NashConv（筹码单位）随训练回合/迭代的变化。
metrics.en: Exploitability or NashConv in chips against training episodes/iterations.

controls.zh: 限定双人 Leduc 规则；图 3 汇总各算法最佳五组种子/超参数，图 4 使用表格算法比较。
controls.en: Fix two-player Leduc rules; Figure 3 averages the top five seed/hyperparameter settings, while Figure 4 compares tabular algorithms.

limits.zh: 平台示范性算法评估，非 OpenSpiel 全游戏统一基准；最佳配置选择有报告偏差风险，不能与随机种子平均数混用。
limits.en: An illustrative platform algorithm evaluation, not a unified OpenSpiel benchmark; selected best configurations must not be confused with averages over arbitrary seeds.

basis.zh: 下注策略必须考虑隐藏牌与对手反应，且以可利用度衡量。
basis.en: Betting policies account for hidden cards and opponent responses and are evaluated by exploitability.

evidence.title: OpenSpiel: A Framework for Reinforcement Learning in Games
evidence.excerpt: Sections 3.1–3.3 and Figures 3–4 report two-player Leduc poker policy learning and exploitability/NashConv in chips; these are concrete examples rather than a single platform-wide score.

gameMembers.noteZh: 论文图 3–4 明确使用双人 Leduc poker；挂接现有 Leduc 节点。
gameMembers.noteEn: Figures 3–4 explicitly use two-player Leduc poker; linked to the existing Leduc node.

evidence.title: OpenSpiel: A Framework for Reinforcement Learning in Games
evidence.excerpt: Sections 3.1–3.3 and Figures 3–4 report two-player Leduc poker policy learning and exploitability/NashConv in chips; these are concrete examples rather than a single platform-wide score.

basis.zh: 已确认 Leduc 的实际策略学习与评估协议；保留平台代表任务身份，未核验全部 OpenSpiel 游戏。
basis.en: Confirmed actual Leduc policy learning/evaluation while retaining its status as a representative platform task; not all OpenSpiel games reviewed.

records.noteZh: 补入 random_maze 明确的交互任务；未固定的实验预算作为限制，不再因此留空任务。
records.noteEn: Registered the explicit random_maze interaction task; unspecified experimental budgets remain a limitation rather than excluding the task.

reviewedScope.zh: DeepMind Lab random_maze 的三分钟回合。
reviewedScope.en: Three-minute DeepMind Lab random_maze episodes.

evidence.title: DeepMind Lab
evidence.excerpt: The platform interface and example-level sections specify random_maze: a new maze each episode, explore then repeatedly return to the goal within three minutes; observations are first-person pixels and actions are movement/look controls.

label.zh: DeepMind Lab：随机迷宫探索与返航
label.en: DeepMind Lab: random-maze exploration and revisiting

task.zh: 每回合探索新生成的迷宫，找到目标后重复导航返回目标以累计奖励。
task.en: Explore a newly generated maze each episode, locate the goal and repeatedly navigate back for reward.

observation.zh: 第一视角 RGB 像素与奖励；RGBD 和速度是平台可选接口，必须按实验显式指定。
observation.en: First-person RGB pixels and reward; RGBD and velocity are optional platform interfaces that must be specified per experiment.

action.zh: 前进/后退、侧移、蹲下/跳跃及两轴视角控制；接口按仿真步同步。
action.en: Forward/backward movement, strafing, crouch/jump and two-axis look controls through a lock-stepped interface.

metrics.zh: 三分钟回合内累计关卡奖励，反映反复到达目标的表现。
metrics.en: Cumulative level reward within a three-minute episode, reflecting repeated goal reaching.

controls.zh: 每回合重新生成迷宫；固定关卡、随机种子、观测模式、仿真帧率和动作重复设置。
controls.en: Regenerate the maze each episode; fix level, seeds, observation mode, simulation frame rate and action repetition.

limits.zh: 论文定义了任务和奖励，但未给此任务一套通用训练预算/种子排行榜；作为平台代表协议，未覆盖所有 Lab 关卡。
limits.en: The paper defines the task and reward but not a universal training-budget/seed leaderboard; this is one representative platform protocol.

basis.zh: 目标和新迷宫布局需通过探索发现。
basis.en: The goal and new maze layout must be discovered by exploration.

basis.zh: 找到目标后需利用本回合已学布局再次返回。
basis.en: After finding the goal, the agent must reuse the layout learned in that episode.

basis.zh: 第一视角导航要求利用迷宫的空间连通关系。
basis.en: Egocentric navigation requires spatial connectivity of the maze.

evidence.title: DeepMind Lab
evidence.excerpt: The platform interface and example-level sections specify random_maze: a new maze each episode, explore then repeatedly return to the goal within three minutes; observations are first-person pixels and actions are movement/look controls.

basis.zh: 补入 random_maze 明确的交互任务；未固定的实验预算作为限制，不再因此留空任务。
basis.en: Registered the explicit random_maze interaction task; unspecified experimental budgets remain a limitation rather than excluding the task.

records.noteZh: 补入赛事文献中明确的单人规划协议；该任务仍保持合集身份，未虚构未公开赛季游戏名单。
records.noteEn: Registered the documented single-player competition protocol as a collection, without inventing private seasonal game lists.

reviewedScope.zh: 2018 综述定义的 GVGAI 单人 planning 赛道。
reviewedScope.en: The GVGAI single-player planning track defined in the 2018 framework paper.

evidence.title: General Video Game AI: a Multi-Track Framework for Evaluating Agents, Games and Content Generation Algorithms
evidence.excerpt: Sections II–III define single-player planning with structured state and forward model, 40 ms decision budget, private validation/test game sets, and rankings ordered by victories, score and game length.

label.zh: GVGAI：未知游戏的单人规划赛道
label.en: GVGAI: single-player planning on unseen games

task.zh: 在不读取 VGDL 规则文件的情况下，对未公开游戏/关卡逐步选择动作，争取获胜和高分。
task.en: Choose actions in withheld games/levels without access to VGDL rule files, aiming to win and score highly.

observation.zh: 游戏时间、得分、胜负、角色位置/资源/生命、碰撞历史与各类精灵位置；提供可复制和推进的前向模型。
observation.en: Time, score, winner, avatar position/resources/health, collision history and sprite positions; a copyable forward model supports simulation.

action.zh: 从游戏当前可用动作选择一个动作；规划中可调用前向模型模拟动作。
action.en: Select one available game action; planning can simulate actions through the forward model.

metrics.zh: 先按胜率、再按得分和游戏长度排序；逐游戏排名积分汇总确定赛道排名。
metrics.en: Order agents by victory rate, then score and game length; aggregate per-game ranking points.

controls.zh: 每组 10 游戏、每游戏 5 关；1 秒初始化、每 tick 40 ms，40–50 ms 罚 no-op、超过 50 ms 取消资格。
controls.en: Ten games per set with five levels each; one-second initialization, 40 ms per tick, no-op penalty at 40–50 ms and disqualification above 50 ms.

limits.zh: 限定原论文单人 planning 赛道；不混入无前向模型的 learning 赛道或生成赛道。具体私有测试游戏随赛季变化。
limits.en: Limited to the paper’s single-player planning track, excluding model-free learning and generation tracks; private test games vary by season.

basis.zh: 可调用前向模型搜索行动后果，在实时预算内选择动作。
basis.en: The forward model supports searching action consequences within a real-time budget.

basis.zh: 最终排名在与公开训练集分开的私有游戏集合上计算。
basis.en: Final rankings use private game sets separate from public training games.

evidence.title: General Video Game AI: a Multi-Track Framework for Evaluating Agents, Games and Content Generation Algorithms
evidence.excerpt: Sections II–III define single-player planning with structured state and forward model, 40 ms decision budget, private validation/test game sets, and rankings ordered by victories, score and game length.

basis.zh: 补入赛事文献中明确的单人规划协议；该任务仍保持合集身份，未虚构未公开赛季游戏名单。
basis.en: Registered the documented single-player competition protocol as a collection, without inventing private seasonal game lists.

records.noteZh: 已核验任务、控制、楼层指标及泛化划分，并区分 25 层实测原型和 100 层设计。
records.noteEn: Verified tasks, controls, floor metrics and generalization splits, distinguishing the evaluated 25-floor prototype from the 100-floor design.

reviewedScope.zh: 原论文 Obstacle Tower 原型及种子/视觉主题泛化协议。
reviewedScope.en: Original Obstacle Tower prototype and seed/theme generalization protocol.

evidence.title: Obstacle Tower: A Generalization Challenge in Vision, Control, and Planning
evidence.excerpt: Sections 2.1–2.3 and 3 define visual tower traversal, multidiscrete controls, floor-completion reward and held-out seed/theme evaluation. The reported prototype has 25 floors, versus the proposed environment’s 100.

label.zh: Obstacle Tower：跨地图与外观的爬塔
label.en: Obstacle Tower: traversal across layouts and visual themes

task.zh: 穿越程序生成楼层，解锁门和谜题、避开障碍，在死亡或时间耗尽前攀登尽可能多的楼层。
task.en: Traverse procedural floors, unlock doors/solve puzzles and avoid hazards to complete as many floors as possible before death or timeout.

observation.zh: 第三视角 RGB（168×168 或缩至 84×84），外加钥匙数量和剩余时间。
observation.en: Third-person RGB at 168×168 or downsampled 84×84, plus key count and remaining time.

action.zh: 前后、左右移动、旋转镜头和跳跃的多离散动作，也可展平为 54 个动作。
action.en: Multidiscrete forward/backward, lateral movement, camera rotation and jump, optionally flattened to 54 actions.

metrics.zh: 每回合完成楼层数的均值/离散程度；稀疏奖励每过一层 +1，密集奖励另奖开门/拿钥匙/解谜。
metrics.en: Mean/distribution of floors completed per episode; sparse reward is +1 per floor, with additional dense rewards for doors, keys and puzzles.

controls.zh: 弱泛化：100 个训练种子、5 个未见测试种子、5 次 agent 随机重复；强泛化另留出视觉主题。
controls.en: Weak generalization: 100 training seeds, five unseen test seeds and five agent-randomness repetitions; strong generalization also holds out a visual theme.

limits.zh: 论文实测原型最高 25 层；不能把未来 100 层环境当作已评测结果。固定奖励模式和视觉主题以保证可比。
limits.en: The evaluated prototype has at most 25 floors; the proposed 100-floor environment is not an evaluated result. Reward mode and visual themes must be fixed.

basis.zh: 以未见地图种子和视觉主题专门检验迁移。
basis.en: Held-out layout seeds and visual themes explicitly test transfer.

basis.zh: 跳跃、转向和避障决定是否继续爬塔。
basis.en: Jumping, steering and hazard avoidance determine survival.

basis.zh: 钥匙、锁门与谜题产生任务先后依赖。
basis.en: Keys, locked doors and puzzles create prerequisite dependencies.

evidence.title: Obstacle Tower: A Generalization Challenge in Vision, Control, and Planning
evidence.excerpt: Sections 2.1–2.3 and 3 define visual tower traversal, multidiscrete controls, floor-completion reward and held-out seed/theme evaluation. The reported prototype has 25 floors, versus the proposed environment’s 100.

basis.zh: 已核验任务、控制、楼层指标及泛化划分，并区分 25 层实测原型和 100 层设计。
basis.en: Verified tasks, controls, floor metrics and generalization splits, distinguishing the evaluated 25-floor prototype from the 100-floor design.

records.noteZh: 数据集论文确实包含闭环 RL/模仿学习基线；接入 Treechop 与 Navigate，明确最佳训练窗口的报告口径。
records.noteEn: The dataset paper includes closed-loop RL/imitation baselines; registered Treechop and Navigate with the best-training-window reporting scope.

reviewedScope.zh: 论文第 5 节的 Treechop、Navigate Sparse/Dense 在线实验。
reviewedScope.en: Online Treechop and sparse/dense Navigate experiments in Section 5.

evidence.title: MineRL: A Large-Scale Dataset of Minecraft Demonstrations
evidence.excerpt: Sections 4.2 and 5 evaluate Treechop and sparse/dense Navigate online. RL uses 1,500 episodes and ten action primitives; Table 1 reports the best contiguous 100-episode average reward.

task.zh: 在森林出生并持有铁斧，收集 64 单位木材或到达任务终止条件。
task.en: Spawn in a forest with an iron axe and collect 64 wood units before termination.

observation.zh: 基线使用缩放至 64×64 的灰度画面；Navigate 另提供指向目标附近位置的指南针。
observation.en: Baselines use 64×64 grayscale frames; Navigate additionally provides a compass toward a position near the goal.

action.zh: 原生键鼠/制作动作在基线中映射为 10 个离散动作原语。
action.en: Native keyboard/mouse/crafting actions are mapped to ten discrete action primitives for the baselines.

metrics.zh: 每收集 1 木材奖励 +1；报告最佳连续 100 回合平均奖励及标准差。
metrics.en: Reward +1 per wood unit; report the best contiguous 100-episode mean reward and standard deviation.

controls.zh: 原论文 RL 训练 1,500 回合（约 12M 帧）；固定任务变体、示范使用和动作映射。
controls.en: Original RL training uses 1,500 episodes (about 12M frames); fix task variant, demonstration use and action mapping.

limits.zh: 最佳训练窗口得分不是独立留出测试；这里只计论文实际在线实验，不把整个示范库或 ObtainDiamond 都算已运行。
limits.en: Best training-window scores are not independent held-out tests; only actual online experiments are counted, not the whole demonstration corpus or ObtainDiamond.

basis.zh: 需靠视觉瞄准、移动和连续砍伐获得木材。
basis.en: Visual aiming, movement and repeated chopping are needed to obtain wood.

evidence.title: MineRL: A Large-Scale Dataset of Minecraft Demonstrations
evidence.excerpt: Sections 4.2 and 5 evaluate Treechop and sparse/dense Navigate online. RL uses 1,500 episodes and ten action primitives; Table 1 reports the best contiguous 100-episode average reward.

task.zh: 穿过程序生成地形到达约 64 格外目标；指南针指向近似位置，最后仍需视觉搜索。
task.en: Traverse procedural terrain to a goal about 64 blocks away; the compass gives an approximate position and final localization requires visual search.

observation.zh: 基线使用缩放至 64×64 的灰度画面；Navigate 另提供指向目标附近位置的指南针。
observation.en: Baselines use 64×64 grayscale frames; Navigate additionally provides a compass toward a position near the goal.

action.zh: 原生键鼠/制作动作在基线中映射为 10 个离散动作原语。
action.en: Native keyboard/mouse/crafting actions are mapped to ten discrete action primitives for the baselines.

metrics.zh: 最佳连续 100 回合平均回报；稀疏版仅到达奖励，密集版另按接近目标的距离给奖励；两版分别报告。
metrics.en: Best contiguous 100-episode mean return; sparse rewards are for arrival, while dense rewards also track progress toward the goal; variants are reported separately.

controls.zh: 原论文 RL 训练 1,500 回合（约 12M 帧）；固定任务变体、示范使用和动作映射。
controls.en: Original RL training uses 1,500 episodes (about 12M frames); fix task variant, demonstration use and action mapping.

limits.zh: 最佳训练窗口得分不是独立留出测试；这里只计论文实际在线实验，不把整个示范库或 ObtainDiamond 都算已运行。
limits.en: Best training-window scores are not independent held-out tests; only actual online experiments are counted, not the whole demonstration corpus or ObtainDiamond.

basis.zh: 需结合指南针方向与非凸地形，选择可行路线到达目标。
basis.en: Compass direction and nonconvex terrain must be combined to find a feasible route.

basis.zh: 指南针位置与真实终点存在偏移，需要局部搜索。
basis.en: The compass target is offset from the actual goal, requiring local search.

evidence.title: MineRL: A Large-Scale Dataset of Minecraft Demonstrations
evidence.excerpt: Sections 4.2 and 5 evaluate Treechop and sparse/dense Navigate online. RL uses 1,500 episodes and ten action primitives; Table 1 reports the best contiguous 100-episode average reward.

basis.zh: 数据集论文确实包含闭环 RL/模仿学习基线；接入 Treechop 与 Navigate，明确最佳训练窗口的报告口径。
basis.en: The dataset paper includes closed-loop RL/imitation baselines; registered Treechop and Navigate with the best-training-window reporting scope.

records.noteZh: 补入论文明确评估的 Sokoban 子游戏；仅使用清楚的逐关卡协议，跨关卡划分待核对代码。
records.noteEn: Registered the explicitly evaluated Sokoban subgame using the clear per-level protocol; cross-level splits still require code reconciliation.

reviewedScope.zh: Griddly 表 1 Sokoban 的逐关卡训练/回报评测。
reviewedScope.en: Per-level Sokoban training/return evaluation in Griddly Table 1.

evidence.title: Griddly: A platform for AI research in games
evidence.excerpt: The GDY environment example, Experiments and Table 1 explicitly specify Sokoban goals, full/egocentric observations and actions. Each level is trained for 1.28M steps; the final 100 episodes yield mean reward.

task.zh: 推动箱子到目标位置；所有箱子完成时满足胜利条件，避免把箱子推入不可恢复布局。
task.en: Push boxes onto targets; all boxes completed satisfy the win condition, while irreversible deadlocks must be avoided.

observation.zh: Vector、Block、Sprite 三种关卡表示；此处仅接入表 1 的逐关卡实验。
observation.en: Vector, Block and Sprite level representations; this unit covers only the per-level experiments in Table 1.

action.zh: 完整可观测实验使用 no-op、上、左、下、右五动作；推进箱子由移动交互触发。
action.en: Fully observable experiments use no-op, up, left, down and right; movement interactions push boxes.

metrics.zh: 每关训练结束前最后 100 回合的平均奖励及离散程度；按关卡和观测类型分别报告。
metrics.en: Mean reward and dispersion over the final 100 training episodes, reported separately by level and observer type.

controls.zh: 每关 1.28M 步，PPO 与 RND；固定关卡、观察器、奖励配置和随机种子。
controls.en: 1.28M steps per level using PPO with RND; fix level, observer, reward configuration and seeds.

limits.zh: 平台实现的代表任务，不等同所有 Sokoban 变体；未把表 2 中存在划分文字歧义的泛化协议并入此单位。
limits.en: A representative platform implementation, not all Sokoban variants; the generalization protocol with ambiguous split wording in Table 2 is excluded.

basis.zh: 箱子推移不可随意撤销，需提前规划目标顺序。
basis.en: Box pushes cannot be freely undone, requiring advance planning of target order.

basis.zh: 墙、箱子与目标的空间关系决定可达性和死锁。
basis.en: Spatial relations among walls, boxes and targets determine reachability and deadlocks.

evidence.title: Griddly: A platform for AI research in games
evidence.excerpt: The GDY environment example, Experiments and Table 1 explicitly specify Sokoban goals, full/egocentric observations and actions. Each level is trained for 1.28M steps; the final 100 episodes yield mean reward.

gameMembers.noteZh: Griddly 论文中的 Sokoban 实现/关卡，保留平台版本身份。
gameMembers.noteEn: The Sokoban implementation/levels in the Griddly paper, retaining platform-version identity.

evidence.title: Griddly: A platform for AI research in games
evidence.excerpt: The GDY environment example, Experiments and Table 1 explicitly specify Sokoban goals, full/egocentric observations and actions. Each level is trained for 1.28M steps; the final 100 episodes yield mean reward.

basis.zh: 补入论文明确评估的 Sokoban 子游戏；仅使用清楚的逐关卡协议，跨关卡划分待核对代码。
basis.en: Registered the explicitly evaluated Sokoban subgame using the clear per-level protocol; cross-level splits still require code reconciliation.

records.noteZh: 补入 ELF 实际 Mini-RTS 完整对局实验，并说明宏动作及信息不对称。
records.noteEn: Registered ELF’s actual full-game Mini-RTS experiments with explicit macro-action and information-asymmetry limits.

reviewedScope.zh: ELF 第 4.2 节 Mini-RTS 对 SIMPLE/HIT N RUN 的实验。
reviewedScope.en: Mini-RTS versus SIMPLE/HIT N RUN in ELF Section 4.2.

evidence.title: ELF: An Extensive, Lightweight and Flexible Research Platform for Real-time Strategy Games
evidence.excerpt: Section 4.2 and Tables 3–4 define Mini-RTS full-game 1v1 versus SIMPLE/HIT N RUN, partial spatial state, nine macro-actions and terminal ±1 reward; results use 10,000 games and five training repetitions.

task.zh: 采集资源、建造设施与部队，摧毁对手基地，分别迎战 SIMPLE 与 HIT N RUN 规则 AI。
task.en: Gather resources, construct facilities/units and destroy the opponent’s base against SIMPLE and HIT N RUN rule-based AIs.

observation.zh: 20×20 多通道空间特征表示可见单位类型/生命与资源；战争迷雾限制信息，但对手基地位置已知。
observation.en: 20×20 multichannel spatial features encode visible unit types/health and resources; fog of war limits information but the enemy base location is known.

action.zh: 9 个全局策略宏动作，具体工人选择/建筑放置等由硬编码执行器完成。
action.en: Nine global strategic macro-actions with hard-coded execution such as worker selection and construction placement.

metrics.zh: 对内置对手的胜率；终局胜/负奖励 +1/−1，报告重复训练的均值和标准差。
metrics.en: Win rate against built-in opponents; terminal win/loss reward is +1/−1, with mean and standard deviation over training repetitions.

controls.zh: 10,000 局评测，5 次训练重复；标准训练 agent frame skip=50，对手 frame skip 单独控制；随机初始状态。
controls.en: 10,000 evaluation games and five training repetitions; standard trained-agent frame skip is 50, with opponent skip controlled separately; randomized initial states.

limits.zh: 宏动作策略评测，不是鼠标级 RTS 微操；内置 AI 可见全局状态，信息优势不对称须保留。
limits.en: Macro-action strategy evaluation, not mouse-level RTS microcontrol; built-in opponents have full-state information, an important asymmetry.

basis.zh: 有限资源需在经济、设施和进攻部队之间取舍，并适应不同对手。
basis.en: Limited resources require trade-offs among economy, facilities and attack forces against different opponents.

basis.zh: 平均约 4,000 ticks 才产生胜负奖励，需维持整局目标。
basis.en: Win/loss reward arrives after roughly 4,000 ticks on average, requiring sustained game-level objectives.

evidence.title: ELF: An Extensive, Lightweight and Flexible Research Platform for Real-time Strategy Games
evidence.excerpt: Section 4.2 and Tables 3–4 define Mini-RTS full-game 1v1 versus SIMPLE/HIT N RUN, partial spatial state, nine macro-actions and terminal ±1 reward; results use 10,000 games and five training repetitions.

basis.zh: 补入 ELF 实际 Mini-RTS 完整对局实验，并说明宏动作及信息不对称。
basis.en: Registered ELF’s actual full-game Mini-RTS experiments with explicit macro-action and information-asymmetry limits.

records.noteZh: 从官方仓库确认具体示例而非仅列平台功能；保留原论文访问失败和示例性质的说明。
records.noteEn: Confirmed a concrete official example rather than platform features, retaining the paper-access failure and example-only scope.

reviewedScope.zh: Malmo 官方 tabular_q_learning.py 与 cliff_walking_1.xml。
reviewedScope.en: Official Malmo tabular_q_learning.py and cliff_walking_1.xml.

evidence.title: Malmo official tabular_q_learning.py
evidence.excerpt: Official tabular Q-learning uses XPos/ZPos and four cardinal moves, adds random lava holes, runs 150 episodes per map and records cumulative reward.

evidence.title: Malmo official Cliff Walking mission
evidence.excerpt: The mission XML terminates on lava or the lapis goal, rewards lava −100 and goal +100, and charges −1 per command.

label.zh: Malmo：Cliff Walking 官方学习示例
label.en: Malmo: official Cliff Walking learning example

task.zh: 在 Minecraft 中构造的悬崖网格绕开熔岩，到达青金石目标方块。
task.en: Navigate the cliff grid constructed in Minecraft, avoiding lava and reaching the lapis goal block.

observation.zh: 官方表格 Q-learning 智能体使用 JSON XPos/ZPos 位置；视频仅用于调试，不是本策略输入。
observation.en: The official tabular Q-learning agent uses JSON XPos/ZPos coordinates; video is for debugging rather than policy input.

action.zh: 向北、南、西、东移动的离散命令。
action.en: Discrete move-north, move-south, move-west and move-east commands.

metrics.zh: 逐回合累计奖励：目标 +100、熔岩 −100、每个命令 −1。
metrics.en: Per-episode cumulative reward: +100 at the goal, −100 for lava and −1 per command.

controls.zh: 基于固定 mission XML 的起点/目标，脚本每张地图额外随机插入熔岩坑；每地图重复 150 回合。比较时记录随机种子和生成布局，触碰熔岩或目标终止。
controls.en: Use fixed mission XML start/goal; the script inserts random lava holes per map and repeats 150 episodes per map. Record random seed and generated layout for comparison; contact with lava or goal terminates the episode.

limits.zh: 官方平台学习示例，不是独立通用 Minecraft 基准或视觉导航评测；原论文 PDF 本轮返回 403，协议依据为作者仓库。
limits.en: An official platform learning example, not an independent general Minecraft benchmark or visual-navigation test; the paper PDF returned 403, so protocol evidence comes from the authors’ repository.

basis.zh: 路径长度与接近熔岩风险影响累计回报，需选择安全到达路线。
basis.en: Path length and lava risk affect return, requiring a safe route to the goal.

basis.zh: 格子位置、障碍和目标之间的关系约束移动路径。
basis.en: Grid positions, hazards and goal relations constrain feasible routes.

evidence.title: Malmo official tabular_q_learning.py
evidence.excerpt: Official tabular Q-learning uses XPos/ZPos and four cardinal moves, adds random lava holes, runs 150 episodes per map and records cumulative reward.

evidence.title: Malmo official Cliff Walking mission
evidence.excerpt: The mission XML terminates on lava or the lapis goal, rewards lava −100 and goal +100, and charges −1 per command.

basis.zh: 从官方仓库确认具体示例而非仅列平台功能；保留原论文访问失败和示例性质的说明。
basis.en: Confirmed a concrete official example rather than platform features, retaining the paper-access failure and example-only scope.

records.noteZh: 竞技对战和 RPG 速通拆为两个游戏专属任务，分别记录指标与 harness 边界。
records.noteEn: Split competitive battles and RPG speedrunning into game-specific units with separate metrics and harness limits.

reviewedScope.zh: PokéAgent 论文第 3 节对战及第 4 节首道馆速通。
reviewedScope.en: PokéAgent Section 3 battling and Section 4 first-gym speedrunning.

evidence.title: The PokeAgent Challenge: Competitive and Long-Context Learning at Scale
evidence.excerpt: Sections 3–4 separate competitive Showdown battles (FH-BT, Glicko-1, GXE) from Emerald first-gym speedrunning (milestone completion, completion time and action count).

task.zh: 在 Gen 1 OU 与 Gen 9 OU 规则下同基线及社区 agent 对战。
task.en: Compete against baseline and community agents under Gen 1 OU and Gen 9 OU formats.

observation.zh: 玩家可见的队伍、当前场面与历史；对方未揭示的队伍配置保持隐藏。
observation.en: Player-visible team, current battle state and history; unrevealed opponent team configuration remains hidden.

action.zh: 每回合同时选择合法招式或换人等对战动作，通常约 9 个可选动作。
action.en: Simultaneously choose legal moves or switches each turn, typically from about nine actions.

metrics.zh: 主要指标为完整对局历史拟合的 FH-BT 评级及 bootstrap 不确定性；另报 Glicko-1 和 GXE。
metrics.en: Primary metric is full-history Bradley–Terry rating with bootstrap uncertainty; Glicko-1 and GXE are also reported.

controls.zh: 专用 AI 服务器，分别报告两种规则及标准/Extended Timer 时限；保持参赛策略固定。
controls.en: Dedicated AI server; report formats and standard/Extended Timer regimes separately, with evaluated policies fixed.

limits.zh: 不是人类公开天梯的同一分布；动态参赛池和最低对局数影响评级，不能跨计时规则直接比较。
limits.en: Not the same distribution as the public human ladder; evolving agent pools and minimum match counts affect ratings, and timer regimes are not directly interchangeable.

basis.zh: 不完全信息、随机招式结果与换人取舍要求对抗策略。
basis.en: Imperfect information, stochastic moves and switching trade-offs require adversarial strategy.

evidence.title: The PokeAgent Challenge: Competitive and Long-Context Learning at Scale
evidence.excerpt: Sections 3–4 separate competitive Showdown battles (FH-BT, Glicko-1, GXE) from Emerald first-gym speedrunning (milestone completion, completion time and action count).

label.zh: PokéAgent：绿宝石首个道馆长程任务

task.zh: 从小田卷相关开局流程推进至击败第一个道馆馆主 Roxanne，完成标准里程碑。
task.en: Progress through the initial journey to defeat first gym leader Roxanne, completing standardized milestones.

observation.zh: 游戏画面及有限队伍物种/等级、状态和 HP；不直接暴露谜题状态、动态障碍、物品和招式集。
observation.en: Game frames and limited party species/levels, status and HP; puzzle states, dynamic obstacles, items and movesets are not directly exposed.

action.zh: 向模拟器发出按键；具体 harness 可加入寻路/知识/记忆工具，须单列其配置。
action.en: Send button inputs to the emulator; harness-specific pathfinding, knowledge and memory tools must be recorded separately.

metrics.zh: 里程碑完成百分比；100% 完成者按完成时间比较，同分以动作次数区分。
metrics.en: Milestone completion percentage; completion time for 100% finishers, with action count as a tie-breaker.

controls.zh: 固定首道馆范围和游戏服务器帧率；比较时按状态、工具、记忆、反馈、微调五轴对齐 harness×model 条件。
controls.en: Fix first-gym scope and server frame rate; align harness×model conditions across state, tools, memory, feedback and finetuning.

limits.zh: 不是完整通关；工具辅助和多 agent 架构不是被独立测量的游戏内协作能力；时间/成本随 harness 变化。
limits.en: Not a full-game completion task; tool assistance and multi-agent architecture do not independently measure in-game cooperation; time/cost vary by harness.

basis.zh: 首道馆流程跨数千次交互，要求持续推进多阶段目标。
basis.en: The first-gym route spans thousands of interactions and sustained multistage objectives.

basis.zh: 路线包含回访、岔路和非线性前置目标。
basis.en: The route includes revisits, branching paths and nonlinear prerequisites.

basis.zh: 长程运行需保留已完成事件与路线进展并处理上下文压缩。
basis.en: Long runs require retaining completed events and route progress through context compaction.

evidence.title: The PokeAgent Challenge: Competitive and Long-Context Learning at Scale
evidence.excerpt: Sections 3–4 separate competitive Showdown battles (FH-BT, Glicko-1, GXE) from Emerald first-gym speedrunning (milestone completion, completion time and action count).

basis.zh: 竞技对战和 RPG 速通拆为两个游戏专属任务，分别记录指标与 harness 边界。
basis.en: Split competitive battles and RPG speedrunning into game-specific units with separate metrics and harness limits.

records.noteZh: 确认这是完整闭环对抗评测；能力依据落在规则应用与策略，而非为所有生成子游戏复制复杂能力。
records.noteEn: Confirmed closed-loop adversarial evaluation; capability attribution is limited to rule application and strategy rather than copied complex capabilities for all generated games.

reviewedScope.zh: gg-bench 的 126 游戏共用规则输入与 30 局/游戏评估协议。
reviewedScope.en: Shared rule-conditioned 30-match-per-game protocol across gg-bench’s 126 games.

evidence.title: Measuring General Intelligence with Generated Games
evidence.excerpt: Sections 2.2–2.4 and 4 specify 126 filtered generated two-player games; each LLM plays 30 matches per game against a selected RL checkpoint, using rulebooks, rendered states and valid actions.

label.zh: gg-bench：新生成规则下的对抗游玩
label.en: gg-bench: adversarial play under generated rules

task.zh: 阅读新生成的双人游戏规则并持续采取行动，击败为该游戏训练的 RL 对手。
task.en: Read generated two-player game rules and act throughout a match to defeat a game-specific RL opponent.

observation.zh: 规则说明、当前棋盘/游戏状态、合法动作列表及动作语义。
observation.en: Rulebook, current board/game state, valid-action list and action semantics.

action.zh: 输出合法动作列表中的一个动作；非法输出会重新提示。
action.en: Output one action from the legal list; invalid outputs trigger reprompting.

metrics.zh: 每游戏 30 局的 LLM 胜率；对 126 游戏的胜率做平均，另分析非法动作错误。
metrics.en: LLM win rate over 30 matches per game, averaged across 126 games; invalid-action faults are analyzed separately.

controls.zh: 固定经过执行/超时筛选的 126 游戏、所选 RL checkpoint；对手从可被另一 checkpoint 以 >80% 胜率击败的配对中选出。
controls.en: Fix the 126 execution/timeout-filtered games and selected RL checkpoints; opponents are chosen from pairs where another checkpoint wins over 80%.

limits.zh: 生成器与筛选策略决定分布，代码仍可能存在边界问题；规则推理是游玩要求，不能解读为独立纯逻辑分数。
limits.en: Generation/filtering define the distribution and edge-case code bugs may remain; rule reasoning is a gameplay requirement, not a separate pure-logic score.

basis.zh: 必须从新规则和动作说明推导当前合法且有效的状态转移。
basis.en: New rules and action descriptions must be applied to legal and effective state transitions.

basis.zh: 最终胜率取决于针对游戏特定 RL 对手的连续对抗决策。
basis.en: Win rate depends on sequential adversarial decisions against game-specific RL opponents.

evidence.title: Measuring General Intelligence with Generated Games
evidence.excerpt: Sections 2.2–2.4 and 4 specify 126 filtered generated two-player games; each LLM plays 30 matches per game against a selected RL checkpoint, using rulebooks, rendered states and valid actions.

basis.zh: 确认这是完整闭环对抗评测；能力依据落在规则应用与策略，而非为所有生成子游戏复制复杂能力。
basis.en: Confirmed closed-loop adversarial evaluation; capability attribution is limited to rule application and strategy rather than copied complex capabilities for all generated games.

records.noteZh: 接入固定 A0 的已定义消融协议；严格区分完成对局统计、自动难度爬升及骨干迁移。
records.noteEn: Registered the defined fixed-A0 ablation, separating completed-run statistics from auto-ladder and cross-backbone probes.

reviewedScope.zh: AgenticSTS 固定 A0 五条件、每条件 10 个完成对局。
reviewedScope.en: AgenticSTS five-condition fixed-A0 comparison, ten completed games per condition.

evidence.title: AgenticSTS: A Bounded-Memory Testbed for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
evidence.excerpt: Sections 3–5 define Slay the Spire 2 typed-state interaction and a five-condition fixed-A0 ablation. First ten completed runs per condition form N=50; victory and floor/boss-derived scores use explicit confidence intervals.

label.zh: AgenticSTS：固定 A0 有界记忆消融
label.en: AgenticSTS: bounded-memory ablation at fixed A0

task.zh: 在 Slay the Spire 2 的 A0 难度完成整次爬塔，连续处理战斗、组牌、路线、事件和奖励选择。
task.en: Complete Slay the Spire 2 runs at A0, making combat, deckbuilding, route, event and reward decisions.

observation.zh: 结构化文本状态、合法动作、规则检索与按条件启用的记忆/技能；不输入无界累积历史。
observation.en: Structured text state, legal actions, rule retrieval and condition-specific memory/skills, without unbounded accumulated transcripts.

action.zh: 按状态类型输出结构化游戏选择；部分简单决策由机械处理器或 fast tier 执行。
action.en: Produce structured game choices by state type; mechanical handlers or a fast tier resolve some simple decisions.

metrics.zh: 完成对局胜率及 Wilson 95% CI；分析分数胜局为 100，否则 floor+(52/3)×bosses，并以 5,000 次 bootstrap 给区间。
metrics.en: Completed-run win rate with Wilson 95% CI; analysis score is 100 on victory, otherwise floor+(52/3)×bosses, with 5,000-bootstrap intervals.

controls.zh: 五条件各取按开始时间最早的 10 个完成对局；A0 固定、记忆库 SHA1888a62 冻结、禁用赛后写入/技能演化。
controls.en: Use the first ten completed games by start time in each of five conditions; fix A0, freeze stores at SHA1888a62 and disable postrun writes/evolution.

limits.zh: 完成对局为分母；五条件非全因子设计，部分对比同时改变多个提示组件；不把自动攀升 A6–A8 混入 A0 胜率。
limits.en: Denominators are completed runs; the five cells are not a full factorial design and some contrasts change multiple prompt components; auto-ladder A6–A8 runs are excluded from A0 win rates.

basis.zh: 明确消融冻结的 episodic memory 与触发式技能，并保持有界上下文合同。
basis.en: Frozen episodic memory and triggered skills are explicitly ablated under a bounded-context contract.

basis.zh: 整次运行跨多阶段和大量决策，要求维持爬塔目标。
basis.en: Whole runs span multiple phases and many decisions requiring sustained objectives.

basis.zh: 组牌、路线和战斗选择影响后续资源与生存。
basis.en: Deckbuilding, route and combat choices affect later resources and survival.

evidence.title: AgenticSTS: A Bounded-Memory Testbed for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
evidence.excerpt: Sections 3–5 define Slay the Spire 2 typed-state interaction and a five-condition fixed-A0 ablation. First ten completed runs per condition form N=50; victory and floor/boss-derived scores use explicit confidence intervals.

basis.zh: 接入固定 A0 的已定义消融协议；严格区分完成对局统计、自动难度爬升及骨干迁移。
basis.en: Registered the defined fixed-A0 ablation, separating completed-run statistics from auto-ladder and cross-backbone probes.

records.noteZh: 已从官方 LLM 仓库确认真实对战、状态动作与回合指标；与尚未完全核验的 2026 赛事计分规则分开。
records.noteEn: Confirmed real matches, observation/action interfaces and round metrics in the official LLM repository, separately from incompletely reviewed 2026 competition scoring.

reviewedScope.zh: 官方 FightingLLM 的 ZEN 对 MctsAi23i 参考运行协议。
reviewedScope.en: Official FightingLLM reference runner: ZEN versus MctsAi23i.

evidence.title: FightingLLM official LLM-versus-MCTS runner
evidence.excerpt: The official FightingLLM runner configures ZEN versus ZEN and MctsAi23i; configurable model, prompt, few-shot count and number of games.

evidence.title: FightingLLM agent and round-result recording
evidence.excerpt: The official prompt serializes HP, energy, action/state, bounding boxes, speeds and projectiles. Agent code executes command actions and records both remaining HPs and elapsed frames at round end.

evidence.title: FightingLLM structured observation prompt
evidence.excerpt: Official prompt generation converts structured frame data into a fighting-game decision prompt.

label.zh: DareFightingICE：官方 LLM 对 MCTS 示例

task.zh: 控制 ZEN 角色实时对战 MctsAi23i，反复根据最新状态选择格斗招式。
task.en: Control ZEN in real-time fights against MctsAi23i, repeatedly selecting fighting moves from updated state.

observation.zh: 双方 HP、能量、当前动作/状态、位置包围盒、速度、弹幕及当前帧编号的结构化文本。
observation.en: Structured text for both fighters’ HP, energy, action/state, bounding boxes, speeds, projectiles and current frame number.

action.zh: 模型输出格斗命令，由 CommandCenter 转为按键序列；后续命令序列可连续执行。
action.en: Model-generated fighting commands are converted by CommandCenter into key sequences; queued commands may execute sequentially.

metrics.zh: 官方 agent 在回合结束记录双方剩余 HP 和经过帧数；代码即时奖励为造成伤害减自身损失。
metrics.en: The official agent records both remaining HP values and elapsed frames at round end; instantaneous reward is damage dealt minus own HP lost.

controls.zh: 固定 ZEN 对 ZEN、MctsAi23i、模型和提示/示例数量；runner 默认 1 局，game_num 可配置；处理逻辑使用 3,600 帧边界。
controls.en: Fix ZEN versus ZEN, MctsAi23i, model and prompt/few-shot settings; runner defaults to one game with configurable game_num; processing uses a 3,600-frame boundary.

limits.zh: 仅接入官方 LLM 参考对战协议，不宣称这些记录字段就是 2026 比赛总排名公式；比赛轮数、评分汇总和最终模型限制仍需核对发布规则包。
limits.en: Only the official LLM reference-match protocol is registered; recorded fields are not asserted to be the 2026 competition ranking formula. Competition round counts, aggregation and final model limits still require the released rules package.

basis.zh: 角色移动、攻击和防御招式需随实时局面反馈执行。
basis.en: Movement, attack and defensive commands must respond to real-time fighting state.

evidence.title: FightingLLM official LLM-versus-MCTS runner
evidence.excerpt: The official FightingLLM runner configures ZEN versus ZEN and MctsAi23i; configurable model, prompt, few-shot count and number of games.

evidence.title: FightingLLM agent and round-result recording
evidence.excerpt: The official prompt serializes HP, energy, action/state, bounding boxes, speeds and projectiles. Agent code executes command actions and records both remaining HPs and elapsed frames at round end.

evidence.title: FightingLLM structured observation prompt
evidence.excerpt: Official prompt generation converts structured frame data into a fighting-game decision prompt.

basis.zh: 已从官方 LLM 仓库确认真实对战、状态动作与回合指标；与尚未完全核验的 2026 赛事计分规则分开。
basis.en: Confirmed real matches, observation/action interfaces and round metrics in the official LLM repository, separately from incompletely reviewed 2026 competition scoring.
